Dialogue (29 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

arcir_start Arcir: “Hello. I'm Arcir.”

  • “I noticed your statue of Elythara downstairs.” (if reached stage 10 of Elythara (hidden flag)) → arcir_elythara_1
  • “You really seem to like your books.” → arcir_books_1
  • “And I'm your delivery kid. Did you order a 'Dusty old book'?” (if hand over 1× Dusty old book; reached stage 10 of Delivery; reached stage 20 of Delivery) → brv_wh_delivery_arcir
  • “What am I supposed to do again?” (if reached stage 40 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_remind_40
  • “The Elytharan ghost still remembers who he was.” (if reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_partial_50
  • “The ghost spoke only of work, of tasks repeated.” (if reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_partial_60
  • “I tried to speak to a ghost, but it would not speak at all.” (if reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_partial_70
  • “I spoke to more than one Elytharan ghost.” (if reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_partial_two
  • “I spoke to more than one Elytharan ghost.” (if reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_partial_two
  • “I spoke to more than one Elytharan ghost.” (if reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_partial_two
  • “The Elytharan ghosts remember different things.” (if reached stage 80 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 90 of Undertell: What was not written) → arcir_undertell_complete_npc

arcir_elythara_1 Arcir: “Oh, you found my statue in the basement? Yes, Elythara is my protector.”

  • “OK.” → arcir_anythingelse

arcir_books_1 Arcir: “I find great pleasure in my books. They contain the accumulated knowledge of past generations.”

  • “Do you have a book called 'Calomyran Secrets'?” (if reached stage 10 of Calomyran secrets) → arcir_calomyran_select
  • “OK.” → arcir_anythingelse
  • “I have found some valuable-looking map. Want to have a look?” (if carry 1× Ewmondold's map; killed 1× Ewmondold) → arcir_books_rares_map
  • “I have found a strange book about slavery. Interested?” (if carry 1× Nasty looking book) → arcir_books_rares_book1
  • “I have a book about world history. Interested?” (if carry 1× World History) → arcir_books_rares_book2
  • “I found a book about Undertell. I thought you might know something about it.” (if NOT reached stage 40 of Undertell: What was not written; carry 1× Undertell: Its Ghosts and History) → arcir_undertell_10

brv_wh_delivery_arcir Arcir: “Yes, an old but useful book, but you should have wiped it off first. Anyway, here's my delivery fee.” — effects: clears stage 20 of Delivery, sets stage 10 of Delivery - nondisplay (hidden flag), gives 20× Gold coins

  • “Thank you.” → conversation ends

arcir_remind_40 Arcir: “I asked you to listen, not for stories, but for failure. If Undertell erased the Elytharan deliberately, it would not do so in only one way. Return. Listen for difference.”

  • “I will return to Undertell.” → conversation ends

arcir_partial_50 Arcir: “Memory of the self endures first. Pain follows identity. Systems are not remembered, they are endured. You must listen again.”

  • “I understand.” → conversation ends

arcir_partial_60 Arcir: “Then you heard structure without belief. A system reveals itself through repetition. You must listen more.”

  • “I understand” → conversation ends

arcir_partial_70 Arcir: “Silence is not absence. It is what remains when speech was never permitted.”

  • “I understand.” → conversation ends

arcir_partial_two Arcir: “Then you have more than one account. That allows comparison, but only if you listen for what does not repeat. Systems reveal themselves at their edges. Return. Do not seek another voice. Seek the limit of speech itself”

  • “I will return once more.” → conversation ends

arcir_undertell_complete_npc Arcir: “Of course they do. History records stone and steel, but memory lives in people even after death. You have given voice to what was buried. That is worth more than any written account.” — effects: sets stage 90 of Undertell: What was not written

  • “I'm glad I could help.” → arcir_anythingelse

arcir_anythingelse Arcir: “Anything else you wanted to ask?”

  • “I noticed your statue of Elythara downstairs.” (if reached stage 10 of Elythara (hidden flag)) → arcir_elythara_1
  • “You really seem to like your books.” → arcir_books_1

arcir_calomyran_select (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 100 of Calomyran secrets) → arcir_calomyran_complete
  • branch 2 (if reached stage 20 of Calomyran secrets) → arcir_calomyran_5
  • branch 3 → arcir_calomyran_1

arcir_books_rares_map Arcir: “Oh, an ancient map of the area! This would fit well into my collection of old maps. I offer you 500 gold pieces for it.”

  • “Thanks, I'd rather keep it.” → arcir_books_1
  • “OK. Here is Ewmondold's map.” (if hand over 1× Ewmondold's map) → arcir_books_rares_map_1

arcir_books_rares_book1 Arcir: “Let's have a look. Oh, what the ... Well, this is no book for little ones as you. Give it to me, you get 200 pieces of gold for it.”

  • “Thanks, I'd rather keep it.” → arcir_books_1
  • “OK. Here is the book about slavery.” (if hand over 1× Nasty looking book) → arcir_books_rares_book1_1

arcir_books_rares_book2 Arcir: “Ah, a history textbook.”

  • Next → arcir_books_rares_book2_1

arcir_undertell_10 Arcir: “Undertell! That book was written carefully. Not to preserve truth, but to survive being questioned. The Aewatha Kingdom was meticulous in year four hundred and thirty-two. Stone was counted. Labor was measured. Voices were not.”

  • “What is it leaving out?” → arcir_undertell_20

arcir_calomyran_complete Arcir: “I heard you found it and gave it back to old man Benradas. Thank you. He tends to forget things.”

  • Next → arcir_anythingelse

arcir_calomyran_5 Arcir: “You looked downstairs but didn't find it? And a note you say? I guess there must have been someone in my house.”

  • Next → arcir_calomyran_6

arcir_calomyran_1 Arcir: “'Calomyran Secrets'? Hmm, yes I think I have one of those in my basement.”

  • Next → arcir_calomyran_2

arcir_books_rares_map_1 Arcir: “And here are 500 shining gold pieces. Use them wisely.” — effects: gives 500× Gold coins

  • “Thanks, I have to go now.” → conversation ends
  • “Let's talk about other things.” → arcir_books_1

arcir_books_rares_book1_1 Arcir: “And here are 200 shining gold pieces. Be happy that I'm freeing you from this terrible work.” — effects: gives 200× Gold coins

  • “Thanks, I have to go now.” → conversation ends
  • “Let's talk about other things.” → arcir_books_1

arcir_books_rares_book2_1 Arcir: “But there are a lot of pages missing. Did you rip them out? You should be ashamed of yourself!”

  • “No, that wasn't me!” → arcir_books_rares_book2_2

arcir_undertell_20 Arcir: “The Elytharan followers sent into those mines did not vanish. They were made unrecordable. If even one of them still remembers themselves, then this book is incomplete. You have already walked Undertell. Return and listen for what the…” — effects: sets stage 40 of Undertell: What was not written, spawns monsters on undertell_1_1

  • “I will return to Undertell and listen.” → conversation ends

arcir_calomyran_6 Arcir: “What did the note say? Larcal ... I know of him. Always causing trouble. He is usually in the barn to the east of here.”

  • “Thanks, bye.” → conversation ends

arcir_calomyran_2 Arcir: “Old man Benradas came by last week, wanting to sell me that book. Since it's not really my kind of book, I declined.”

  • Next → arcir_calomyran_3

arcir_books_rares_book2_2 Arcir: “Such a beautiful book, completely broken! You dare to offer this to me and think I won't notice?!”

  • “[Run]” → arcir_books_rares_book2_3
  • “Let's talk about other things.” → arcir_books_1

arcir_calomyran_3 Arcir: “He seemed upset that I didn't like his book, and threw it at me while storming out of the house.”

  • Next → arcir_calomyran_4

arcir_books_rares_book2_3 Arcir: “Yes, just run away, you book murderer!”

arcir_calomyran_4 Arcir: “Poor old man Benradas, he probably forgot that he left it here. He tends to forget things.”

  • Next → arcir_anythingelse

  • “They used their magic on your ring, and asked that I give it back to you.” → arensia_lytwing_26

arensia_lytwing_23 Arensia: “So ... what did they say?”

  • “The lytwings finally agreed to leave you in peace.” → arensia_lytwing_24

arensia_lytwing_35 Arensia: “But I see you have the ring I gave them. You told me they kept it, which can only mean that you lied to me. You are just a common thief. Shame on you.”

  • “But, I ... um ....” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_36 Arensia: “I see you have my magical ring. I hope it serves you well, you deserve it.”

  • “I keep it safe, and it keeps me safe in return.” → conversation ends

arensia_letter_20 Arensia: “[Reading] Oh that's cute. Tell Gorwath I love him too.” — effects: sets stage 20 of You're the postman

  • “I'll be happy to tell him that.” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_2 Arensia: “I am being taunted by naughty lytwings at night. At least that is what Rigmor tells me. They play with my hair while I sleep, and tangle it into fairy-lock knots. Every morning I wake up tired, and I spend an hour brushing out the knots.…”

  • “I am sorry to hear that, but I cannot help you right now.” → arensia_lytwing_3
  • “That sounds awful, can I help in any way?” → arensia_lytwing_4

arensia_lytwing_33 Arensia: “You should talk to Rigmor, as she knows more about the lytwings than I do. She lives here in Fallhaven, just go north past the tavern.” — effects: sets stage 1 of It's knot funny

  • “Okay.” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_27 Arensia: “I can't say that I have noticed it. A few days ago I was picking mushrooms to the west of here.”

arensia_lytwing_11 Arensia: “Oh wonderful! An odd request nonetheless.”

  • “I better go and find those fruit.” → conversation ends
  • “Where can I find apples and strawberries?” → arensia_lytwing_12

arensia_lytwing_8 Arensia: “Please keep me updated.”

  • “I will.” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_10 Arensia: “Okay thanks for letting me know. Don't let them wait too long.”

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_8

arensia_lytwing_7 Arensia: “Oh that is great news! If you need an axe, check with Jakrar, my father, over there.”

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_8

arensia_lytwing_13 Arensia: “Oh no, they sound very difficult to deal with. I hope it gets better.”

  • “Thank you.” → arensia_lytwing_8

arensia_lytwing_14 Arensia: “I am so sorry.”

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_8

arensia_lytwing_28 Arensia: “They sure are a greedy bunch!”

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_8

arensia_lytwing_30 Arensia: “How can I help?”

  • “Where can I find wild flowers?” (if NOT carry 1× Wild Flower) → arensia_lytwing_31
  • “I found some wild flowers, I just need a few more.” (if carry 1× Wild Flower; NOT carry 12× Wild Flower) → arensia_lytwing_37
  • “I have found a dozen wild flowers. I will take them to the lytwings.” (if carry 12× Wild Flower) → arensia_lytwing_37
  • “Will this ever end?” → arensia_lytwing_15

arensia_lytwing_18 Arensia: “Oh please tell me that is the end of it?”

  • “I'm afraid not, they still want more.” → arensia_lytwing_15

arensia_lytwing_19 Arensia: “Of course! anything!”

  • “You have to make this promise to a piece of jewellery, which I will take back to them.” → arensia_lytwing_20

arensia_lytwing_32 Arensia: “Oh I hope they accept it, and I hope they are done with their silly errands.”

  • “Me too.” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_25 Arensia: “That is okay. I did not expect to get it back.” — effects: sets stage 102 of It's knot funny

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_9

arensia_lytwing_26 Arensia: “After everything you have done for me ... I want you to keep it. Please, I insist!” — effects: sets stage 103 of It's knot funny

  • “That is very generous, I won't forget it.” → arensia_lytwing_9

arensia_lytwing_3 Arensia: “I understand. I guess I will just have to live with their mischief, and hope that I don't lose my hair, or my sanity!”

  • “Good luck.” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_4 Arensia: “You would be willing to help me? I would be so grateful if you could make them leave me alone.”

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_33

arensia_lytwing_12 Arensia: “You can buy apples at the Fallhaven tavern. Not sure about strawberries though.”

  • “OK, thanks anyway.” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_31 Arensia: “Look to the south, and southeast from here. You will see the wild flowers growing next to the trees.”

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_30

arensia_lytwing_37 Arensia: “Those flowers look perfect.”

arensia_lytwing_15 Arensia: “You have done so much for me already. I will understand if you want to quit, I won't blame you.”

  • “I want to see this through.” → arensia_lytwing_16
  • “The lytwings are driving me insane. I thought about this, and I can't help you any more. I am sorry.” → arensia_lytwing_29

arensia_lytwing_20 Arensia: “I know, I will promise on this ring I'm wearing. It belonged to my mother, and it's dear to me, but I will do anything to stop the lytwings!”

  • “I hope this works.” → arensia_lytwing_21

arensia_lytwing_9 Arensia: “Thank you so much for helping me with the lytwings!”

  • “You are welcome!” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_16 Arensia: “You are too kind!”

  • Next → arensia_lytwing_8

arensia_lytwing_29 Arensia: “Are you sure that you want to quit?”

  • “Yes, I want to quit.” → arensia_lytwing_17
  • “On second thought, I want to see this through.” → arensia_lytwing_16

arensia_lytwing_21 Arensia: “I made a promise to the ring, here take it to the lytwings!” — effects: gives 1× Arensia's Ring of Promise, sets stage 91 of It's knot funny

  • “I will, right away!” → conversation ends

arensia_lytwing_17 Arensia: “I appreciate your help either way.” — effects: sets stage 101 of It's knot funny

  • “Goodbye.” → conversation ends

Dialogue (13 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

arghes (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 51 of Search for Andor) → arghes_2
  • branch 2 → arghes_1

arghes_2 Arghes: “How interesting. The child from Fallhaven, here in Remgard?”

  • “I'm not from Fallhaven, I'm from Crossglen, west of Fallhaven.” → arghes_3a
  • “Who are you?” → arghes_3b
  • “How do you know where I am from?” → arghes_3c
  • “And how interesting that you ordered a pair of 'Yellow boots'. Did you really order this?” (if hand over 1× Yellow boot; reached stage 10 of Delivery; reached stage 80 of Delivery) → brv_wh_delivery_arghes

arghes_1 Arghes: “You will find no business here, child.”

arghes_3a Arghes: “Is that so? Hmm, most interesting. It does not change anything, however.”

  • Next → arghes_4

arghes_3b Arghes: “Who I am is of no importance in this situation. You on the other hand, are most important.”

  • Next → arghes_4

arghes_3c Arghes: “I know ... a great deal of things.”

  • Next → arghes_4

brv_wh_delivery_arghes Arghes: “Yes kid, thank you. Here, take this gold for them.” — effects: clears stage 80 of Delivery, sets stage 70 of Delivery - nondisplay (hidden flag), gives 50× Gold coins

  • “You're welcome.” → conversation ends
  • “Bye.” → conversation ends

arghes_4 Arghes: “$playername - yes, that is what they call you.”

  • “How do you know my name? Who are you?” → arghes_5

arghes_5 Arghes: “Let's just say that I am a ... friend. You would do well to keep your ... friends close.”

  • Next → arghes_6

arghes_6 Arghes: “Now, how may I help you? Equipment? Information?”

  • “Let me see what you have to trade.” → arghes_shop
  • “What information do you have?” → arghes_7

arghes_shop Arghes: “Certainly.”

  • Next → shop opens

arghes_7 Arghes: “Hmm, let me see.”

  • Next → arghes_8

arghes_8 Arghes: “No, I cannot tell you anything at this time. You are welcome to return once your path has become ... clearer.”

docs.text:
• Well rested: stages 20, 30, 40
  • Hidden: events in bwm (hidden flag): stages 22
Dialogue (29 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

arghest_start (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • Next (if reached stage 47 of Climbing up is forbidden; NOT reached stage 22 of Hidden: events in bwm (hidden flag)) → arghest_alert
  • branch 2 (if reached stage 40 of Well rested) → arghest_return_1
  • branch 3 (if reached stage 30 of Well rested) → arghest_return_2
  • branch 4 → arghest_1

arghest_alert Arghest: “Hey, do you know what's happening here? These serious-looking soldiers entered the mine without permission.”

  • “They're soldiers of Feygard. I came along with them. Don't worry.” → arghest_alert_2
  • “I'll investigate. Bye.” → conversation ends

arghest_return_1 Arghest: “Welcome back. Thanks for your help earlier. I hope the room at the inn can be of use to you.”

  • “You are welcome. Goodbye.” → conversation ends
  • “Can I enter the mine?” (if NOT reached stage 22 of Hidden: events in bwm (hidden flag)) → arghest_6
  • “Can I enter the mine?” (if reached stage 22 of Hidden: events in bwm (hidden flag)) → arghest_15

arghest_return_2 Arghest: “Welcome back. Did you bring me the 5 bottles of milk that I requested?”

  • “No, not yet. I'm working on it.” → arghest_return_3
  • “Yes, here you go, enjoy!” (if hand over 5× Milk) → arghest_return_4
  • “Yes, but this nearly cost me a fortune!” (if hand over 5× Milk) → arghest_return_4

arghest_1 Arghest: “Hello there.”

  • “What is this place?” → arghest_2
  • “Who are you?” → arghest_5
  • “Did you rent the back room at the inn in Prim?” (if reached stage 10 of Well rested) → arghest_8

arghest_alert_2 Arghest: “You'd better be telling me the truth. I will report it later.”

  • “Have you seen a guy with a cloak around here?” → arghest_alert_3
  • “Yeah, whatever. We will talk later.” → conversation ends

arghest_6 Arghest: “No. The mine is closed.”

  • “OK, goodbye.” → conversation ends
  • “Please?” → arghest_7

arghest_15 Arghest: “Suit yourself... But no one else went in there in weeks.”

  • “Thanks, bye.” → conversation ends
  • “If you say so.” → conversation ends

arghest_return_3 Arghest: “OK then. Return to me once you have them.”

  • “Will do. Goodbye.” → conversation ends

arghest_return_4 Arghest: “Thank you my friend! Now I can restock my supply.” — effects: sets stage 40 of Well rested

  • Next → arghest_return_5

arghest_2 Arghest: “This is the old Elm mine of Prim.”

  • Next → arghest_3

arghest_5 Arghest: “I am Arghest. I guard the entrance here to make sure no one enters the old mine.”

  • “What is this place?” → arghest_2
  • “Can I enter the mine?” (if NOT reached stage 22 of Hidden: events in bwm (hidden flag)) → arghest_6
  • “Can I enter the mine?” (if reached stage 22 of Hidden: events in bwm (hidden flag)) → arghest_15

arghest_8 Arghest: “'Inn in Prim' - you sound funny.”

  • Next → arghest_9

arghest_alert_3 Arghest: “I was taking a break in the beds over there, so no idea. Sorry. No one usually comes here but you and those ... noisy soldiers.”

  • “Maybe you should take another break now?” → arghest_alert_4
  • “Can I do something for you?” → arghest_alert_5

arghest_7 Arghest: “I said no. Visitors are not allowed in there.”

  • “Please?” → arghest_6
  • “Just a quick peek?” → arghest_6

arghest_return_5 Arghest: “These bottles look excellent. Now I can last a while longer in here.”

  • Next → arghest_return_6

arghest_3 Arghest: “We used to mine a lot here. But that was before the attacks started.”

  • Next → arghest_4

arghest_9 Arghest: “Yes, I rent it. I stay there to rest when my shift ends.”

  • Next → arghest_10

arghest_alert_4 Arghest: “I'd prefer something to drink. No milk this time, better something to warm my body.”

  • “What exactly are you thinking of?” → arghest_alert_5

arghest_alert_5 Arghest: “Once I had got a potion from some crazy old guy in a foreign wood. That would be great now. 'Lodar' he was called.”

  • “Would you like this 'Minor potion of strength'?” (if hand over 1× Minor potion of strength) → arghest_alert_8
  • “I have this 'Improved defense' potion. Here, take it.” (if hand over 1× Potion of improved defense) → arghest_alert_8
  • “What about his famous 'Perilous concoction'?” (if hand over 1× Lodar's perilous concoction) → arghest_alert_8

arghest_return_6 Arghest: “Oh, and about the room in the inn - you are welcome to use it in any way you see fit. Quite a cozy place to rest if you ask me.”

  • “Thanks Arghest. Goodbye.” → conversation ends
  • “Finally, I thought I would never be able to rest here!” → conversation ends

arghest_4 Arghest: “The attacks on Prim by the beasts, the bandits and the disappearances really reduced our numbers. Now we cannot keep up the mining activity any longer.”

  • “Who are you?” → arghest_5

arghest_10 Arghest: “However, now that we guards aren't as plentiful as we used to be, it has been a while since I could rest in there.”

  • “Mind if I use the room at the inn to rest in?” → arghest_11
  • “Are you still going to use it?” → arghest_11

arghest_alert_8 Arghest: “Really? Many many thanks - you make my old heart cry!” — effects: sets stage 22 of Hidden: events in bwm (hidden flag)

  • “[muttering] I hope so. The potion was expensive enough!” → arghest_alert_9

arghest_11 Arghest: “Well, I would like to still keep the option of using it. But I guess someone else could rest there now that I'm not actively using it.” — effects: sets stage 20 of Well rested

  • Next → arghest_12

arghest_alert_9 Arghest: “You may enter the mine now. But you have to find out for yourself, I won't go looking for you.”

  • “Great.” → conversation ends
  • “At last.” → conversation ends
  • “Don't worry, I won't cause too much trouble.” → conversation ends

arghest_12 Arghest: “Tell you what, if you bring me some more supplies to keep me occupied here, I guess you could have my permission to use it even though I have rented it.”

  • Next → arghest_13

arghest_13 Arghest: “I have plenty of meat here, but I ran out of milk some weeks ago. Do you think you could help me restock my milk supply?”

  • “Sure, no problem. I'll get you your bottles of milk. How much do you need?” → arghest_14
  • “Sure, if it leads to me being able to rest here. I'm in.” → arghest_14

arghest_14 Arghest: “Bring me 5 bottles of milk. That should be enough.” — effects: sets stage 30 of Well rested

  • “I'll go buy some.” → conversation ends
  • “OK. I'll be right back.” → conversation ends

• A cat and mouse game: stages 40
  • A strange looking dagger: stages 115, 120, 130, 200, 230
  • brv_nondisplay2 (hidden flag): stages 42
  • brv_nondisplay_multipurpose (hidden flag): stages 50
Dialogue (23 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

arlish_0 Arlish: “Hello. I'm Arlish, the proprietor. This is a general store, so I sell some of this, some of that, and a little bit of the other. Would you like to see what I have?”

  • “Yes, please show me.” → shop opens
  • “No thanks.” → conversation ends
  • “The teacher said that you would give me a cake.” (if reached stage 40 of brv_nondisplay2 (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 42 of brv_nondisplay2 (hidden flag)) → arlish_10
  • “The teacher said that you would give me a cake.” (if reached stage 42 of brv_nondisplay2 (hidden flag)) → arlish_20
  • “What can you tell me about Lawellyn's dagger?” (if reached stage 110 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 115 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 120 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 200 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 230 of A strange looking dagger) → arlish_asd_0
  • “I want to talk about the investigation.” (if reached stage 130 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 200 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 230 of A strange looking dagger) → arlish_asd_100
  • “I need to find a large empty bottle. Do you have one?” (if reached stage 20 of A cat and mouse game; reached stage 30 of A cat and mouse game; NOT reached stage 40 of A cat and mouse game) → arlish_bottle_1

arlish_10 Arlish: “Sure. You must have done something very good. Wait a second...”

  • Next → arlish_12

arlish_20 Arlish: “Yes, but only one.”

  • “One could try...” → conversation ends

arlish_asd_0 Arlish: “Why? What do you know about it?”

  • “Well, I have it right here.” (if hand over 1× Assassin's blade) → arlish_asd_20
  • “Well, I have it right here.” (if wearing (and give up) Assassin's blade) → arlish_asd_20
  • “You have looked at the dagger. Can you tell me more?” (if reached stage 50 of brv_nondisplay_multipurpose (hidden flag)) → arlish_asd_30
  • “I was just curious, I was told that a dagger I had was Lawellyn's, but I no longer have it.” (if NOT carry 1× Assassin's blade; NOT wearing Assassin's blade; NOT reached stage 50 of brv_nondisplay_multipurpose (hidden flag)) → arlish_asd_15
  • “Nothing. I was just curious. Bye.” → conversation ends

arlish_asd_100 Arlish: “What about it?”

  • “I'm sorry, but I was not able to find any new information that would determine what happened to your father.” (if reached stage 190 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 200 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 230 of A strange looking dagger) → arlish_asd_110
  • “I'm still investigating. I'll come back when I have more information.” (if NOT reached stage 190 of A strange looking dagger; NOT reached stage 220 of A strange looking dagger) → conversation ends
  • “I have some good news for you.” (if reached stage 220 of A strange looking dagger) → arlish_asd_140

arlish_bottle_1 Arlish: “Well, that's an unusual request. What would you need such a thing for?”

  • “Seviron at the church needs it. I'm just helping out.” → arlish_bottle_2
  • “Nevermind. If you don't have one you should just say so. I'll look elsewhere.” → conversation ends

arlish_12 Arlish: “Shall I cut it for you?”

  • “Yes, please.” → arlish_16
  • “No, thank you. I prefer the cake as a whole.” → arlish_14

arlish_asd_20 Dummy NPC: “Arlish takes the dagger and examines it while you continue to talk.” — effects: sets stage 50 of brv_nondisplay_multipurpose (hidden flag)

  • “I was able to acquire the dagger and its gem. Then Edrin repaired it for me.” → arlish_asd_30

arlish_asd_30 Arlish: “This can't be it. It looks like my father's dagger, but his dagger has been missing for a couple of years now. I believe this is stolen property!”

  • “Tell me more.” → arlish_asd_40
  • “So what. You said it has been missing for years, so how would you know?” → conversation ends

arlish_asd_15 Arlish: “Well, he did have a dagger, but I can't say if the one you had was his if I can't look at it.” — effects: sets stage 115 of A strange looking dagger

arlish_asd_110 Arlish: “I'm sorry too. Thank you for trying.” — effects: sets stage 200 of A strange looking dagger

arlish_asd_140 Arlish: “I know you do. I heard that you found my father's murderer.”

  • Next → arlish_asd_120

arlish_bottle_2 Arlish: “Well, I do happen to have one. I don't display it as shop inventory because I've never been asked for such a thing before. Since it's for the church, you can have it for free.” — effects: sets stage 40 of A cat and mouse game, gives Large empty bottle

arlish_16 Arlish: “Well, I'm cutting the cake into 8 large pieces. I hope they taste good to you!” — effects: gives 8× Piece of cake, sets stage 42 of brv_nondisplay2 (hidden flag)

  • “Thank you.” → conversation ends

arlish_14 Arlish: “I'm afraid you'll get a stomachache if you eat the whole cake at once. But well - here you have it.” — effects: gives 1× Cake, sets stage 42 of brv_nondisplay2 (hidden flag)

  • “Thank you.” → conversation ends

arlish_asd_40 Arlish: “You see, this was my father Lawellyn's most prized possession. He kept it with him always.”

  • “Please go on.” → arlish_asd_50

arlish_asd_120 Arlish: “I should have known that it was Ogea! He never agreed with my father's decision about the land.”

  • Next → arlish_asd_130

arlish_asd_50 Arlish: “Then one night, father did not come to my place for dinner as was the custom. I quickly became worried that something terrible had happened to him. So I went to Mustura for help, but she quickly pushed it off as 'Lawellyn simply went on a…”

  • Next → arlish_asd_60

arlish_asd_130 Arlish: “It would be my honor if you take Lawellyn's dagger. He would want you to have it.” — effects: sets stage 230 of A strange looking dagger, gives 1× Assassin's blade

  • “Thank you, but it was my honor to help bring you closure and justice.” → conversation ends

arlish_asd_60 Arlish: “But I tried to explain to her that Lawellyn would not do so without telling me.”

  • “That sounds suspicious.” → arlish_asd_70

arlish_asd_70 Arlish: “Indeed it does. In fact, I fear he was murdered. Will you help?”

Dialogue (36 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

aulowenn0 (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 31 of No rest for the guilty) → aulowenn_atk
  • branch 2 (if reached stage 60 of No rest for the guilty) → aulowenn_wb0
  • branch 3 (if reached stage 40 of No rest for the guilty) → aulowenn_k0
  • branch 4 (if reached stage 11 of No rest for the guilty) → aulowenn_ms0
  • branch 5 → aulowenn1

aulowenn_atk (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 30 of No rest for the guilty) → aulowenn_atk1
  • branch 2 → aulowenn_atk0

aulowenn_wb0 Aulowenn: “Welcome back my friend. Thank you for helping me defeat that foul creature that was haunting the grave of my fellow guards.”

  • Next → aulowenn_k1

aulowenn_k0 Aulowenn: “Excellent. Maybe now my brethren can rest peacefully. Thank you so much for helping me.” — effects: sets stage 40 of No rest for the guilty

  • Next → aulowenn_k1

aulowenn_ms0 Aulowenn: “Hello again. Were you successful in defeating that beast?”

  • “What was I supposed to do again?” → aulowenn16
  • “Yes, I defeated the creature.” (if hand over 1× Tiqui's shield) → aulowenn_k0
  • “Not yet. I'll do it soon enough though.” → aulowenn21
  • “I don't think I should get involved in this.” → aulowenn21b
  • “I'll go visit the graves, but I can't promise that I'll kill anyone.” → aulowenn21b
  • “I met Tiqui by those graves. He had an interesting tale to tell.” (if reached stage 22 of No rest for the guilty) → aulowenn_tq0

aulowenn1 Aulowenn: “Halt! Do not come any closer. The contents of these crates is property of Feygard.”

  • “I mean you no harm. Who are you?” → aulowenn2
  • “Sure. I'll just stay right here. Who are you?” → aulowenn2
  • “Fine. I will leave.” → conversation ends

aulowenn_atk1 (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken) — effects: sets stage 65 of No rest for the guilty

  • branch 1 → aulowenn_atk0

aulowenn_atk0 Aulowenn: “For Feygard!” — effects: sets stage 31 of No rest for the guilty

  • “Attack!” → fight starts

aulowenn_k1 Aulowenn: “In return, you are very welcome to use my bed to rest whenever you wish.” — effects: sets stage 60 of No rest for the guilty

aulowenn16 Aulowenn: “As I mentioned, some of my men were killed by the local creatures here. We buried them to the east of here.”

  • Next → aulowenn17

aulowenn21 Aulowenn: “Good. Return here once you are done.”

aulowenn21b Aulowenn: “You do as you wish. I'll be here regardless.”

aulowenn_tq0 Aulowenn: “You actually listened to it? Please, indulge me, what lies did it have you believe?”

  • “He told me that you have been killing off his kin.” → aulowenn_tq1

aulowenn2 Aulowenn: “I am Aulowenn of Feygard.”

  • “What are you doing out here?” → aulowenn3

aulowenn17 Aulowenn: “I haven't been there for a few days now, but last I visited the graves, there was one of those foul creatures standing over the graves.”

  • Next → aulowenn18

aulowenn_tq1 Aulowenn: “Of course we have! They've been attacking us, and we've taken precautions by hunting them so they can't kill more of us.”

  • Next → aulowenn_tq2

aulowenn3 Aulowenn: “I'm guarding these crates. That's what I do. At least until my company gets back from their scouting party.”

  • Next → aulowenn4

aulowenn18 Aulowenn: “I've seen that particular creature there before, it seems to be haunting the graves of my fellow men.”

  • Next → aulowenn19

aulowenn_tq2 Aulowenn: “To think that they believe they have a chance against the forces of Feygard. Hah! We will cut them down like sheep once the reinforcements get here.”

  • “I should leave before there is more bloodshed.” → aulowenn21b
  • “I don't like your tone. They haven't done anything to you.” → aulowenn_tq4
  • “I was also asked to take care of you, and I intend to do just that.” → aulowenn_tq3

aulowenn4 Aulowenn: “Oh I hope they do get back. Come to think of it, they have been away for quite some time now.”

  • Next → aulowenn5

aulowenn19 Aulowenn: “Of course, it must be up to no good. I would like your help in either removing or defeating that thing.”

  • “So, you want me to go visit the graves to the east and defeat whatever creature is there?” → aulowenn20

aulowenn_tq4 Aulowenn: “Hah! See, there are those lies that I told you about. They. Attacked. Us. Get it?”

  • “You will be no match for me.” → aulowenn_atk
  • “I should leave before there is more bloodshed.” → conversation ends

aulowenn_tq3 Aulowenn: “Hah! Take care of me? That will be the day.”

  • “You will be no match for me.” → aulowenn_atk
  • “I should leave before there is more bloodshed.” → conversation ends

aulowenn5 Aulowenn: “I sure hope they are well. Unlike the others...”

  • “What about the others?” → aulowenn6

aulowenn20 Aulowenn: “Yes, that's it. I should also warn you that those creatures are intelligible, so I would urge you to act quickly when encountering it, before it can spew its foul lies.” — effects: sets stage 11 of No rest for the guilty

  • “Sounds easy enough. I'll do it.” → aulowenn21
  • “Great, more blood for my sword. I'll do it.” → aulowenn21
  • “Anything to help a fellow Feygard friend.” → aulowenn21a
  • “I don't think I should get involved in this.” → aulowenn21b
  • “I'll go visit the graves, but I can't promise that I'll kill anyone.” → aulowenn21b
  • “I have already killed it.” (if hand over 1× Tiqui's shield) → aulowenn_k0

aulowenn6 Aulowenn: “In my squad, we were a band of six guards that, together with other squads, were sent out here to find a dangerous madman that takes his refuge somewhere in the nearby hills around here.”

  • Next → aulowenn7

aulowenn21a Aulowenn: “Glory to Feygard. Return here once you are done.”

aulowenn7 Aulowenn: “But something started to happen once we got here. Some of my fellow guards started acting ... odd.”

  • Next → aulowenn8

aulowenn8 Aulowenn: “I don't know if it was just me imagining things or if something truly happened to them. Anyway, one by one, we started to get fewer and fewer.”

  • Next → aulowenn9

aulowenn9 Aulowenn: “Some of my men were killed by the creatures that live in these woods, some ran away by themselves and some have never come back from their scouting trips.” — effects: sets stage 10 of No rest for the guilty

  • “What do you think has happened to them?” → aulowenn10

aulowenn10 Aulowenn: “I have two theories. My first thought is that some of the local creatures that we've been having problems with here might have captured them, or even killed them. I know for a fact that some were killed by the creatures, since we even…”

  • Next → aulowenn11

aulowenn11 Aulowenn: “The creatures in these woods are intelligible, but fierce. Luckily, we've been able to kill them off before they've been able to spew their foul lies. There are still a few of them around though.”

  • Next → aulowenn12

aulowenn12 Aulowenn: “My second theory is that the madman that we are looking for must have done something to them. Maybe the madman has smeared some of his madness onto them.”

  • Next → aulowenn13

aulowenn13 Aulowenn: “Regardless, there isn't much that I am able to do here. I need to guard these crates.”

  • Next → aulowenn14

aulowenn14 Aulowenn: “Also, I do hope that those creatures that seem to live here don't return. They've been a real pest.”

  • “Anything I can do to help?” → aulowenn15
  • “Good luck with that. Goodbye.” → conversation ends

aulowenn15 Aulowenn: “Oh yes, would you? There is one thing you could do.”

  • Next → aulowenn16

docs.title: Quests
docs.text:
• A Wicked witch: stages 10
  • A giant snake: stages 10, 90
  • You shall pass: stages 150
  • Room to rent (hidden flag): stages 10
Dialogue (31 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

bela_gsnake (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 90 of A giant snake; NOT reached stage 50 of A Wicked witch; NOT reached stage 70 of A Wicked witch; NOT reached stage 95 of A Wicked witch; NOT reached stage 96 of A Wicked witch) → bela_witch_10
  • branch 2 (if reached stage 90 of A giant snake) → bela
  • branch 3 (if killed 1× Giant snake) → bela_gsnake_20
  • branch 4 (if reached stage 10 of Everything in order) → bela_gsnake_1
  • branch 5 → bela

bela_witch_10 Bela: “Did you hear about the kidnapping?”

  • “It wasn't me!” (if reached stage 75 of Immaculate kidnapping) → bela_witch_15
  • “Someone kidnapped Ambelie?” (if reached stage 76 of Immaculate kidnapping) → bela_witch_16
  • “No, I don't think so.” → bela_witch_20
  • “Not now, I have something else to talk about.” (if reached stage 140 of You shall pass; NOT reached stage 150 of You shall pass; have 4,850 gold) → bela_rain_gold_10

bela Bela: “Welcome to Fallhaven Tavern. Have a seat anywhere.”

  • “Let me see what food and drinks you have available.” → bela_select
  • “Are there any rooms available?” → bela_room_select
  • “Torilo suggested that I ask other tavern owners such as yourself about a 'business agreement' that you may have with a…” (if latest stage of Beer Bootlegging is 20) → bela_beer
  • “Do you have strawberries?” (if latest stage of It's knot funny is 11) → bela_lytwing_strawberries
  • “Please keep these 4,850 gold coins for safekeeping. Rain asked for you until he gets over his hangover, he'll come…” (if latest stage of You shall pass is 140; pay 4,850 gold) → bela_rain

bela_gsnake_20 Bela: “You are back!”

  • “Sure. And your little snake monster is no more.” → bela_gsnake_21

bela_gsnake_1 Bela: “I'm glad you are still alive!”

  • “As you know I can handle myself.” → bela
  • “Why? Has something happened?” → bela_gsnake_2

bela_witch_15 Bela: “[Looking extermely confused and terrified] ... Well, why would it be you?”

  • “Nevermind.” → bela_witch_20

bela_witch_16 Bela: “[Looking extermely confused] ... Who?”

  • “Nevermind” → bela_witch_20

bela_witch_20 Bela: “Well, while you were off hunting and killing that giant snake, I had a customer.”

  • “So?” → bela_witch_25

bela_rain_gold_10 Bela: “What is more important than a kidnapping?”

  • “Please keep these 4,850 gold coins for safekeeping. Rain has asked for you until he gets over his hangover, he'll come…” (if pay 4,850 gold) → bela_rain

bela_select (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 120 of Delicious soup) → bela_trade_2
  • branch 2 → bela_trade_1

bela_room_select (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 10 of Room to rent (hidden flag)) → bela_room_3
  • branch 2 → bela_room_1

bela_beer Bela: “Who is Torilo?”

  • “Come on. You know who Torilo is.” → bela_beer_10

bela_lytwing_strawberries Bela: “I don't, but I believe the potion merchant here in Fallhaven has some.”

  • “OK.” → bela

bela_rain Bela: “Definitely. Count on me. Glad you could help him, the poor sod.” — effects: sets stage 150 of You shall pass, removes monsters from fallhaven_nw, spawns monsters on fallhaven_nw

bela_gsnake_21 Bela: “Incredible! Let's feast now! Everyone have a free drink!” — effects: sets stage 90 of A giant snake, gives 1× Mead

bela_gsnake_2 Bela: “Did you not hear of the most dangerous snake ever seen? It has been spotted on Fallhaven's southern border.”

  • “A snake?” → bela_gsnake_3
  • “No, I didn't hear, and I also don't want to. Please give me something to drink.” → shop opens

bela_witch_25 Bela: “A customer with a very interesting report about a kidnapped girl and a witch.” — effects: sets stage 10 of A Wicked witch

  • “Is this customer still here?” → bela_witch_30

bela_trade_2 Bela: “I have some new soup now, from Gison and Nimael. It's expensive, but worth the money.”

  • “Sounds interesting.” → shop opens

bela_trade_1 Bela: “I have a variety of food and drinks.”

  • “OK. Please show me.” → shop opens

bela_room_3 Bela: “I hope the room suits your needs. It's the last room down at the end of the hall.”

  • “Thank you. There was something else I wanted to talk about.” → bela
  • “Thanks, bye.” → conversation ends

bela_room_1 Bela: “A room will cost you only 10 gold.”

  • “[Buy for 10 gold]” (if pay 10 gold) → bela_room_2
  • “I really need to rest but I don't have 10 gold. I will wash the dishes. [Wash the dishes]” (if NOT have 10 gold; reached stage 1 of The ruthless Crackshot) → bela_room_2
  • “Umar sent me.” (if reached stage 20 of misc_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → bela_room_2
  • “No thanks.” → bela

bela_beer_10 Bela: “No, really, I don't know anyone by that name.”

  • “Sure you do. He is the owner of the Foaming flask.” → bela_beer_20

bela_gsnake_3 Bela: “No normal snake. Huge as a house! Making noise like a hundred galloping horses!”

  • Next → bela_gsnake_4

bela_witch_30 Bela: “That's the thing. He is no longer here. He just left before you walked in.”

  • Next → bela_witch_31

bela_room_2 Bela: “OK. Take the last room down at the end of the hall.” — effects: sets stage 10 of Room to rent (hidden flag)

  • “Thank you. There was something else I wanted to talk about.” → bela
  • “Thanks, bye.” → conversation ends

bela_beer_20 Bela: “the 'Foaming flask', what is that? Is that a tavern?”

  • “I've had enough of you. If you want to play dumb, then I don't have time for you.” → conversation ends

bela_gsnake_4 Bela: “Few people dare to walk outside of the city nowadays.”

  • “Sounds interesting.” → bela_gsnake_10
  • “Thanks for the warning. I'll avoid that area.” → bela_gsnake_5

bela_witch_31 Bela: “You should ask around town if anyone has seen or heard about it.”

  • “OK. I think I will do that. Thanks.” → conversation ends
  • “OK, but first please give me something to drink.” → shop opens

bela_gsnake_10 Bela: “Oh no - what have I done? I shouldn't have talked of the giant snake. Promise me you won't go there!”

  • “Well, if it makes you happy.” → bela_gsnake_5
  • “Of course I'll go there.” → bela_gsnake_11

bela_gsnake_5 Bela: “Good. Enough of such dark words - now go, have a seat anywhere.”

  • “Let me see what food and drinks you have available.” → shop opens
  • “Are there any rooms available?” → bela_room_select

bela_gsnake_11 Bela: “What a waste of such a young, promising life! Well...don't forget to pay your tab before you leave my tavern.” — effects: spawns monsters on gapfiller2, sets stage 10 of A giant snake

docs.title: Quests
docs.text:

  • The ruthless Crackshot: stages 11
  • You shall pass: stages 60, 70, 100, 110, 120
Dialogue (46 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

benbyr (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 10 of The ruthless Crackshot; NOT reached stage 11 of The ruthless Crackshot) → benbyr_guild03_1
  • branch 2 (if reached stage 40 of You shall pass; carry 1× Trader's Guild bronze coin; NOT reached stage 70 of You shall pass) → benbyr_shannal_10
  • branch 3 (if latest stage of You shall pass is 70) → benbyr_step_70
  • branch 4 (if reached stage 90 of You shall pass; NOT reached stage 120 of You shall pass) → benbyr_restitution_10
  • branch 5 (if reached stage 60 of Cheap cuts) → benbyr_declined
  • branch 6 (if reached stage 30 of Cheap cuts) → benbyr_complete_1
  • branch 7 (if reached stage 20 of Cheap cuts) → benbyr_mission_1
  • branch 8 → benbyr_story_1

benbyr_guild03_1 Benbyr: “(This man seems to be immersed in his thoughts)”

  • “Hi. Have you heard about the murder not far from here?” → benbyr_guild03_2

benbyr_shannal_10 Benbyr: “What do you want?”

  • “To show you this traders' coin.” → benbyr_shannal_20

benbyr_step_70 Benbyr: “Have you t-t-talked to the ghost y-y-yet? P-p-please hurry.”

  • “I will go now.” → conversation ends

benbyr_restitution_10 Benbyr: “W-w-w-well?”

  • “You have to make restitution.” → benbyr_restitution_20

benbyr_declined Benbyr: “I have nothing more to say to you. Leave me.”

benbyr_complete_1 Benbyr: “Hello again. We sure showed that bastard Tinlyn. That should teach him not to mess with me again.”

benbyr_mission_1 Benbyr: “Ah, my walking accident returns. He he.”

  • “Can you tell me your story again?” → benbyr_story_4
  • “I am still looking for those sheep.” → benbyr_accept_3
  • “I have slain all eight of Tinlyn's sheep for you.” (if hand over 8× Meat from Tinlyn's sheep) → benbyr_mission_2

benbyr_story_1 Benbyr: “Psst, hey. Over here.”

  • Next → benbyr_story_2

benbyr_guild03_2 Benbyr: “What? A murder? I don't know what you're talking about, sorry.” — effects: sets stage 11 of The ruthless Crackshot

  • “Civilians! You never see anything. Bye.” → conversation ends
  • “OK, thank you anyway!” → conversation ends

benbyr_shannal_20 Benbyr: “W-w-w-where did you get t-t-t-that?”

  • “A ghost near Galmore Mountain asked me to show it to you.” → benbyr_shannal_30

benbyr_restitution_20 Benbyr: “W-w-whatever y-y-you say.”

  • “You need to pay Shannal's descendant.” → benbyr_restitution_30

benbyr_story_4 Benbyr: “A while ago, I did some business with a certain man called Tinlyn, over here at this Crossroads guardhouse.”

  • Next → benbyr_story_5

benbyr_accept_3 Benbyr: “Return to me with proof that you have slain all eight of them.”

benbyr_mission_2 Benbyr: “Ha ha! That fool Tinlyn must be in tears. The Shadow surely walks with you my friend.” — effects: sets stage 30 of Cheap cuts

  • Next → benbyr_complete_2

benbyr_story_2 Benbyr: “You look like an aspiring adventurer. Are you willing to do some ... [Benbyr pauses] ... adventuring? He he.”

  • “What are we talking about here?” → benbyr_story_3_1
  • “Depends on what I get in return.” → benbyr_story_3_2
  • “I try to help people wherever they might need help.” → benbyr_story_3_3

benbyr_shannal_30 Benbyr: “G-g-g-g-almore! I am dead.”

  • “Why is that?” → benbyr_shannal_40

benbyr_restitution_30 Benbyr: “I have to pay this person? How can you be serious? Look at me, I just recently got of that Feygard prison. I don't have any gold.”

  • “Well, that's not my problem.” → benbyr_restitution_40

benbyr_story_5 Benbyr: “As to the nature of our business, I can't really tell you. Let's just say that our business was of the kind that was mutually beneficial and the guards did not know about it.”

  • Next → benbyr_story_6

benbyr_complete_2 Benbyr: “This is a glorious day indeed! Tinlyn should have known not to mess with me!”

  • Next → benbyr_complete_3

benbyr_story_3_1 Benbyr: “Straight to the point eh? I like that.”

  • Next → benbyr_story_4

benbyr_story_3_2 Benbyr: “Ah, the adventurer seeks compensation. Tell me, is the thrill of an adventure not reward enough?”

  • “Yes, you are right.” → benbyr_story_4
  • “No.” → benbyr_story_3_4

benbyr_story_3_3 Benbyr: “The noble adventurer. He he, I like that. Yes, you will do fine.”

  • Next → benbyr_story_4

benbyr_shannal_40 Benbyr: “Oh well, we're not proud of it. My ancestor was one of those who would force or capture people to work in the mines of Undertell. He would be paid in these coins to get these people.” — effects: sets stage 60 of You shall pass

  • “What is that coin? What does it mean?” → benbyr_shannal_50

benbyr_restitution_40 Benbyr: “All I have is fifty gold, I swear of it.” — effects: sets stage 100 of You shall pass

  • “Are you kidding me? Let me call the ghost - she must be nearby...” → benbyr_restitution_50

benbyr_story_6 Benbyr: “We were ready to finish the big deal, me and Tinlyn. That's when he decided to turn on me.”

  • Next → benbyr_story_7

benbyr_complete_3 Benbyr: “As for you my friend, seek out my friends in Brightport. I am sure they would extend their hospitality to you.”

benbyr_story_3_4 Benbyr: “Then I will surely disappoint you. Return to me once you are ready for my task.”

benbyr_shannal_50 Benbyr: “Can't really say. We're not happy about it. He was the black sheep of the family.”

  • “Like you're any better. The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.” → benbyr_shannal_60

benbyr_restitution_50 Benbyr: “N-n-no, I found some more in my other pocket. I have 500 gold.” — effects: sets stage 110 of You shall pass

  • “A pittance.” → benbyr_restitution_60

benbyr_story_7 Benbyr: “He reported me to the guards, and made me take the whole blame for our business.”

  • Next → benbyr_story_8

benbyr_shannal_60 Benbyr: “A ghost asked you to show m-m-me? I'm dead. Since the ghost is here after all these years, it could be looking for revenge. My life for her suffering.”

  • “Old sins cast long shadows. However, perhaps I could talk to her, ask her to spare you?” → benbyr_shannal_70

benbyr_restitution_60 Benbyr: “H-h-how about a 1,000?”

  • “Old sins cast long shadows. Try harder.” → benbyr_restitution_70

benbyr_story_8 Benbyr: “I was sent to Feygard prison, while he himself was set free for reporting me.”

bjorgur_return_1 Bjorgur: “Hello again, friend. Thank you for your assistance with my family grave earlier.”

bjorgur_return_2 Bjorgur: “Hello again. Have you investigated if anything has happened to my family grave?”

  • “No, not yet.” → bjorgur_9
  • “[Lie] I went to check on the grave. Everything seems to be normal. You must be imagining things.” (if reached stage 60 of Awoken from slumber) → bjorgur_return_3
  • “What was I supposed to do again?” → bjorgur_3
  • “Yes. I killed the intruder and restored the dagger to its original place.” (if reached stage 40 of Awoken from slumber) → bjorgur_complete_1

bjorgur_1 Bjorgur: “Hello there. You wouldn't happen to know anything about a grave to the southwest of Prim would you?”

  • “I have been there. I met someone on one of the lower levels.” (if reached stage 30 of Awoken from slumber) → bjorgur_2
  • “What about it?” → bjorgur_3
  • “No, sorry.” → bjorgur_3

bjorgur_9 Bjorgur: “Please hurry, and return here to tell me of your progress once you find out something.”

bjorgur_return_3 Bjorgur: “Nothing you say? But I was sure something must have happened over there. Anyway. Thank you for checking it for me.”

bjorgur_3 Bjorgur: “My family grave is located in the tomb to the southwest of Prim right outside the Elm mine. I fear that something has disturbed the peace there.”

  • Next → bjorgur_4

bjorgur_complete_1 Bjorgur: “An intruder? Oh thank you for dealing with this matter.”

  • Next → bjorgur_complete_2

bjorgur_2 Bjorgur: “You have been there?”

  • Next → bjorgur_5

bjorgur_complete_2 Bjorgur: “You say you restored the dagger to it's original place? Thank you. Now I might be able to rest during the nights ahead.”

  • Next → bjorgur_complete_3

bjorgur_5 Bjorgur: “The dagger would of course attract treasure hunters, but up until now we seem to have been spared of this.”

  • Next → bjorgur_6

bjorgur_complete_3 Bjorgur: “Thank you again. I'm afraid I can't give you anything except my gratitude. You should go see my relatives in Feygard if you get the chance to travel up there.” — effects: sets stage 50 of Awoken from slumber

bjorgur_6 Bjorgur: “Now I fear something has happened to the grave. I have not been sleeping well the last couple of nights, and I am sure this must be the cause.” — effects: sets stage 10 of Awoken from slumber

  • Next → bjorgur_7

bjorgur_7 Bjorgur: “You wouldn't happen to want to go check on the grave and see what is happening over there?”

  • “Sure. I will go check on your parents grave.” → bjorgur_8
  • “A treasure you say? I'm interested.” → bjorgur_8
  • “I have actually already been there and restored the dagger to its original place.” (if reached stage 40 of Awoken from slumber) → bjorgur_complete_2

bjorgur_8 Bjorgur: “Thank you. Please see if anything has happened to the grave, and what could be the cause of my nightly anxiety.” — effects: sets stage 15 of Awoken from slumber

bogsten_115_10 Bogsten: “Now what has happened down there?”

  • “I've finally defeated Zuul'khan and his giant mushroom. You won't have to worry about them anymore.” (if reached stage 200 of Fungi panic) → bogsten_200_10

bogsten_70_10 Bogsten: “It took you a long time to get back here. What has happened down there?”

  • “I met an old sorcerer named Zuul'khan in the cave.” → bogsten_70_20

bogsten_granny_94 Undina Bogsten: “So you've chosen my gardening gloves. A wise choice!”

  • Next → bogsten_granny_96

bogsten_granny_92 Undina Bogsten: “Ah, so you found your way downstairs. Smart child, it was a pleasure to meet you. Farewell!”

bogsten_granny_90 Undina Bogsten: “It was a pleasure to meet you. Farewell, kid!”

bogsten_granny_10 Undina Bogsten: “Bogsten, my dear great-grandchild! After all these years you come to visit me again!”

  • “Sorry, I am not of your family. I am $playername from Crossglen.” → bogsten_granny_20

bogsten_granny_96 Undina Bogsten: “There used to be also a family-owned cookbook. Unfortunately that has been lost. It contained valuable recipes - the mushroom soup in particular was a dream!”

  • Next → bogsten_granny_90

bogsten_granny_20 Undina Bogsten: “Really? My eyes don't seem to be as clear as they used to be.”

  • Next → bogsten_granny_30

bogsten_granny_30 Undina Bogsten: “Where is this naughty boy? He should have come for cleaning every week.”

  • “He is dead.” (if killed 1× Bogsten) → bogsten_granny_32
  • “I met him in the house upstairs. He was very ill.” (if NOT killed 1× Bogsten) → bogsten_granny_34
  • “I don't know.” → bogsten_granny_40

  • Next → bogsten_granny_40

  • Next → bogsten_granny_40

bogsten_granny_40 Undina Bogsten: “I never could stand that spoiled kid. He only ever comes to get new gold from the family treasure.”

  • “How ungrateful!” → bogsten_granny_42

bogsten_granny_42 Undina Bogsten: “Ungrateful indeed. I would rather give our gold to some random beggar than to see it squandered by him.”

  • Next → bogsten_granny_50

bogsten_granny_50 Undina Bogsten: “Tell me child, where are you going in the world?”

  • “My father sent me to find my brother Andor. He left some time ago and hasn't come back yet.” → bogsten_granny_52

bogsten_granny_52 Undina Bogsten: “It really is an honorable goal. I like you, my child. Truly.”

  • “Did you see my brother? He looks a bit like me.” → bogsten_granny_54

bogsten_granny_54 Undina Bogsten: “No, I haven't seen Andor. I hope that you will find him soon and that you can return to your father together.”

  • “My father will be very glad.” → bogsten_granny_60

bogsten_granny_60 Undina Bogsten: “How touching! I will give you something. You really deserve a little gold.”

  • “Oh, you don't have to!” → bogsten_granny_80
  • “At last some gold.” → bogsten_granny_80

Dialogue (15 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

brenor_selector (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if carry 1× Heartstone) → brenor_refuse_10
  • branch 2 (if wearing #heartsteel_filter) → brenor_heartsteel_10
  • branch 3 (if NOT carry 1× Heartstone) → brenor_intro_10

brenor_refuse_10 Brenor: “I will not speak while that glowing stone is in your pack. It stirs old pain. Set it down and return if you want my words.”

  • “All right. I will set it down.” → conversation ends
  • “Then we are done here.” → conversation ends

brenor_heartsteel_10 Brenor: “That weapon...must you hold it where I can see it? Even in death I know its glow.”

  • “Is something wrong with it?” → brenor_heartsteel_20

brenor_intro_10 Brenor: “The pick is light in my hand and heavy in my memory. We were driven into the deep seams with only a lamp and a promise. Many never climbed back.”

  • “Who are you?” (if reached stage 40 of Undertell: What was not written) → brenor_who_20
  • “What was it like down there?” (if reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written) → brenor_story_30
  • “I should go.” → conversation ends

brenor_heartsteel_20 Brenor: “Wrong? To you it is a finely forged weapon. To us...it was an executioner's tool.”

  • “Executioner's tool?” → brenor_heartsteel_30

brenor_who_20 Brenor: “My name was Brenor. I came from the lands ruled by Feygard, back when its people still followed Elythara. I was taken during the rise of Garthan I, when those who held to the Light were chained and sent below the mountain. I swung this…” — effects: sets stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written

  • “I am sorry, Brenor.” → conversation ends
  • “What happened in the mines?” → brenor_story_30
  • “I will leave you be.” → conversation ends

brenor_story_30 Brenor: “Dark, cold, and full of smoke. The tunnels shook when the rock groaned. We dug at glowing seams until our hands bled. The overseers said the ore was precious to Nor City, though none of us were told why. We were tools, nothing more.”

  • “You endured much hardship.” → brenor_memory_40
  • “Is there anything I can do to honor you?” → brenor_help_50
  • “I must continue my search.” (if reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 80 of Undertell: What was not written) → brenor_reward_qs80
  • “I must go now.” → conversation ends

brenor_heartsteel_30 Brenor: “When the Shadow rose, many who came for the Elytharans carried heartsteel. It cut through armor with frightening ease, but that was never what we feared most.” — effects: sets stage 100 of hidden_undertell (hidden flag)

  • “What did you fear?” → brenor_heartsteel_40

brenor_memory_40 Brenor: “Hardship was the only thing we owned. The mountain took the rest. But remembering us is enough. Few living souls do.”

  • “I will remember that, but I must continue my search.” (if reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 80 of Undertell: What was not written) → brenor_reward_qs80
  • “I will remember that.” → conversation ends

brenor_help_50 Brenor: “Speak the names of the lost when you can. We were men once, not shadows in stone. That is all a slave could hope for.”

  • “I will honor your memory by continuing my search.” (if reached stage 50 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 60 of Undertell: What was not written; reached stage 70 of Undertell: What was not written; NOT reached stage 80 of Undertell: What was not written) → brenor_reward_qs80
  • “I will honor your memory.” → conversation ends

brenor_reward_qs80 Brenor: “Sure, you do that.” — effects: sets stage 80 of Undertell: What was not written

brenor_heartsteel_40 Brenor: “Those struck down by heartsteel often found no peace. Too many never reached Elythara's embrace. Instead, they lingered...as you see us now.”

  • “So these weapons created the ghosts?” → brenor_heartsteel_50

brenor_heartsteel_50 Brenor: “No. The weapon was only a tool. It was those who wielded it, and the darkness they served, that filled our halls with restless souls.”

  • “I never knew any of this.” → brenor_heartsteel_60

brenor_heartsteel_60 Brenor: “I believe you. Had I thought otherwise, I would not have spoken with you. Keep your weapon if you must, but remember what it once meant to my people.”

  • “Thank you for telling me.” → brenor_heartsteel_70

brenor_heartsteel_70 Brenor: “If you want to talk about something else, then please, get it out of my sight.”

  • “Understood.” → conversation ends

  • Next (if reached stage 80 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 120 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 240 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 211 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 135 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk9
  • Next (if reached stage 240 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_gunfryk17
  • Next (if reached stage 211 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_gunfryk11
  • Next (if reached stage 50 of Priceful vengeance; reached stage 135 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 136 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_gunfryk_killfail0
  • Next (if reached stage 50 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 135 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_gunfryk2
  • Next → brightport_gunfryk

brightport_gunfryk_selectorafter (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • Next (if reached stage 120 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk_help
  • Next (if reached stage 150 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk_help
  • Next (if reached stage 140 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk_help
  • Next (if reached stage 60 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk_selector_after

brightport_gunfryk9 Gunfryk: “Any progress on that investigation of yours?”

  • “I found their hideout and inside was this blade.” (if hand over 1× Nor city made blade; reached stage 130 of Priceful vengeance; reached stage 110 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk16
  • “I found a bunch of goods hidden in a cave east, here's a blade I took.” (if hand over 1× Nor city made blade; NOT reached stage 130 of Priceful vengeance; reached stage 110 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk11
  • “Sorry, I couldn't find anything.” (if reached stage 130 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk14
  • “Sorry, I couldn't find anything.” (if reached stage 110 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 130 of Priceful vengeance; NOT carry 1× Nor city made blade) → brightport_gunfryk21
  • “Not yet. But I'll find something substantial soon.” → brightport_gunfryk10

brightport_gunfryk17 Gunfryk: “Most interesting, Nor City made? Nothing of that sort passes through our checkpoints without permission. Yes, that warrants an investigation. What are the name of these criminals?”

  • “Barthold and Dynes sir.” → brightport_gunfryk18

brightport_gunfryk11 Gunfryk: “Most interesting, Nor City made? Nothing of that sort passes through our checkpoints without permission. Yes, that warrants an investigation. What are the name of these criminals?” — effects: sets stage 211 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

  • “Barthold and Dynes sir.” → brightport_gunfryk12

brightport_gunfryk_killfail0 Dummy NPC: “The commander extends his arm to grab your shoulder.”

  • Next → brightport_gunfryk_killfail

brightport_gunfryk2 Gunfryk: “Lizardman you say? That is extremely serious. I will call my men and we will hurry to save him!” — effects: sets stage 50 of Priceful vengeance, removes monsters from brightport_bakery, sets stage 234 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

brightport_gunfryk Gunfryk: “I'm the guard commander. Inform me or my men if you spot any trouble.” — effects: sets stage 156 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

  • “[Lie] My friend was chased by a lizardman and he went inside the derelict house east of town. Please save him!” (if NOT reached stage 80 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 60 of Priceful vengeance; reached stage 30 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 150 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 136 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 50 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk2
  • “I heard you really love orchids, Sir Gunfryk. [Blackmail him with the records.]” (if reached stage 40 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 60 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 135 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk3
  • “Sir, I have some information on two troublemakers in town who wish to see you gone.” (if reached stage 30 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 60 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 50 of Priceful vengeance; NOT reached stage 135 of Priceful vengeance) → brightport_gunfryk1
  • “Can you tell me more about your job?” → brightport_gunfryk0

brightport_gunfryk_help Gunfryk: “It's good to see you around, glory to Feygard.”

  • “Can you tell me more about your job?” → brightport_gunfryk0

brightport_gunfryk_selector_after Gunfryk: “It sours my day to see a treacherous criminal rat. You and your friends will regret this one day.”

brightport_gunfryk16 Dummy NPC: “You remember the deal you made with Barthold and Dynes, even though they gave you the money you still handed the evidence over to the guards.” — effects: sets stage 240 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

  • Next → brightport_gunfryk17

brightport_gunfryk14 Gunfryk: “That is understandable. I was a bit hopeful, we've long needed a reason to nail down the coffin of the remaining criminals in town.”

  • Next → brightport_gunfryk15

brightport_gunfryk21 Gunfryk: “That is understandable. I was a bit hopeful, we've long needed a reason to nail down the coffin of the remaining criminals in town.”

  • Next → brightport_gunfryk22

brightport_gunfryk10 Gunfryk: “I see, good luck with that.”

brightport_gunfryk18 Dummy NPC: “You're not sure if what you're feeling right now is guilt, or the feeling of breaking a promise.”

  • “[I do feel a little bad.]” → brightport_gunfryk19
  • “[They deserved it.]” → brightport_gunfryk19

brightport_gunfryk12 Gunfryk: “Well done, $playername. They will be apprehended as soon as I give my men the order. As for you, a reward is most deserving, here is some gold.”

  • Next → brightport_gunfryk13

brightport_gunfryk_killfail Gunfryk: “Is your friend safe?! I sent my men to the derelict manor and they caught a Nor city spy, but no trace of any lizardmen or your friend!” — effects: spawns monsters on brightport_jail

  • “Umm. Ermm. He is alright sir.” → brightport_gunfryk_killfail2

brightport_gunfryk3 Gunfryk: “What? [The commander gulps dryly.] Who told you that? And anyway, my favorites are orchids!” — effects: sets stage 150 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

  • “I also heard you love rolling in the flower fields and smelling the roses. I think the others would love hearing that…” → brightport_gunfryk4

brightport_gunfryk1 Gunfryk: “Those Nor City agitators are a dime a dozen; however, we can only act under Feygard law. The first thing we need is evidence.”

  • “What could serve as evidence?” → brightport_gunfryk6

brightport_gunfryk0 Gunfryk: “We protect Brightport from the critters of the wilderness and barbaric monsters such as those lizardmen. All by decree of our king, Lord Geomyr.”

  • Next → Brightport_gunfryk1

brightport_gunfryk15 Gunfryk: “This time was a miss, but we sure need more brave youngsters like you who are not afraid to speak up. Glory to Feygard!” — effects: sets stage 140 of Priceful vengeance, sets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

brightport_gunfryk22 Gunfryk: “This time was a miss, but we sure need more brave youngsters like you who are not afraid to speak up. Glory to Feygard!” — effects: sets stage 135 of Priceful vengeance

brightport_gunfryk19 Gunfryk: “We sure need more brave, law-upholding youngsters like you around! I'll make sure to write to my superiors about it. After graduating from the academy here, be sure to give the military academy a try. Glory to Feygard!” — effects: sets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag), sets stage 150 of Priceful vengeance, spawns monsters on brightport_benbyr, starts timer “brightport_arrest”, sets stage 120 of Priceful vengeance, sets stage 212 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

  • Next → brightport_gunfryk20

brightport_gunfryk13 Gunfryk: “We sure need more brave, law-upholding youngsters like you around! I'll make sure to write to my superiors about it. After graduating from the academy here, be sure to give the military academy a try. Glory to Feygard!” — effects: gives 700× Gold coins, spawns monsters on brightport_benbyr, sets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag), sets stage 120 of Priceful vengeance, sets stage 212 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag), starts timer “brightport_arrest”

brightport_gunfryk_killfail2 Gunfryk: “Then that is good, and if not for you we wouldn't have gone there and found that spy. You can have his cloak, well done.” — effects: sets stage 60 of Boxed in, sets stage 136 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag), gives 1× Agent's cloak

  • “[Elysa will be mad at me...]” → conversation ends

brightport_gunfryk4 Gunfryk: “Grr... This is blackmail. I get it. What is it? What do you want?”

  • “You've put my two acquaintances, Dynes and Barthold, in a tough spot with your rules. I'd appreciate it if you gave…” → brightport_gunfryk5

brightport_gunfryk6 Gunfryk: “Reputable eyewitnesses. Records. In case of swindling or smuggling, illegal merchandise. Word of mouth means nothing.”

  • “I think I heard them mention a smuggling cave of sorts, that they use to evade the law.” → brightport_gunfryk7

Brightport_gunfryk1 Gunfryk: “With us around all those Nor City thugs are shaking in their boots, Brightport has never been safer.”

brightport_gunfryk20 Dummy NPC: “What is certain, however, is that if there's any honor among Nor City's thieves, they'll surely have none to spare for you.”

brightport_gunfryk5 Gunfryk: “Have it your way, and keep those papers away from my subordinates. If word got out, my reputation would be ruined! But don't think this will last for long...” — effects: sets stage 60 of Priceful vengeance

brightport_gunfryk7 Gunfryk: “As if they could ever evade the watchful eyes of my men! Although...”

  • Next → brightport_gunfryk8

brightport_gunfryk8 Gunfryk: “If you came here to tell me, there may be some truth to your words, kid. If you want to do the right thing for the glory of Feygard, then see if you can find anything I could order my men to act on. But don't stick your neck out too much,…” — effects: sets stage 80 of Priceful vengeance

  • “I'll do my best, Glory to Feygard!” → conversation ends
  • “Sure, but I'm doing this because I want to, not because of your silly laws.” → conversation ends

Dialogue (8 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

brightport_tyliad (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • Next (if reached stage 95 of The balance of scales) → brightport_tyliad1
  • Next (if NOT reached stage 95 of The balance of scales) → brightport_tyliad2

brightport_tyliad1 Tail-swing-tyliad: “You are worthy of our trust now, but don't overstep, outsider.”

  • “Can you tell more about the lizard people?” → brightport_tyliad3

brightport_tyliad2 Tail-swing-tyliad: “Carry out your purpose, outsider. Don't dissapoint.”

brightport_tyliad3 Tail-swing-tyliad: “Our ancestors, been inhabiting the bright lake for many generations, until you, men without scales, drove us away to the mountains.”

  • Next → brightport_tyliad4

brightport_tyliad4 Tail-swing-tyliad: “Us men with scales acknowledge strength, and accept defeat. But mountain have little food, so we fought each other and separate. We came here, others swam north. And we created many tribes.”

  • “Tribes?” → brightport_tyliad5

brightport_tyliad5 Tail-swing-tyliad: “Many, but what remains are three great tribes. Us green-fang, honorable brave warriors, the lineage of heroes.”

  • Next → brightport_tyliad6

brightport_tyliad6 Tail-swing-tyliad: “Yellow-tail, greedy and cunning. Love to eat gold and steal.”

  • Next → brightport_tyliad7

brightport_tyliad7 Tail-swing-tyliad: “And the barbaric red-scale, violent and slowminded, never listen to reason.”

  • “You're not friends with them? Phew!” → conversation ends

Dialogue (19 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

brightport_lizardking (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • Next (if reached stage 90 of The balance of scales) → brightport_elyzard8
  • Next (if reached stage 60 of The balance of scales; NOT reached stage 95 of The balance of scales) → brightport_elyzard4
  • Next (if reached stage 40 of The balance of scales; NOT reached stage 60 of The balance of scales) → brightport_elyzard1
  • Next (if NOT reached stage 40 of The balance of scales) → brightport_elyzard

brightport_elyzard8 Three-fang-elyzard: “You are welcome here, outsider. Rest well.”

brightport_elyzard4 Three-fang-elyzard: “Help the Shadow Chaplain with task, only then our trust be restored.”

  • “I helped Dominio with his task.” (if reached stage 127 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_elyzard5

brightport_elyzard1 Three-fang-elyzard: “Outsider, have you returned with the bones?”

  • “Yes, 13 as promised.” (if hand over 13× Lizardman bone) → brightport_elyzard2
  • “Not yet.” → brightport_elyzard0_1

brightport_elyzard Three-fang-elyzard: “I have heard from Emyro. You come before me, but there can be no talk before you return what the witch stole!”

  • “I swear to return what was taken from you, what should I do?” → brightport_elyzard0_0
  • “I've changed my mind, we will talk with our swords!” → brightport_lizardkingfight

brightport_elyzard5 Three-fang-elyzard: “The spirits of our kin see your worth, outsider. Accept this gift from our tribe's great treasures.” — effects: sets stage 90 of The balance of scales, gives 1× Argentscale diadem

  • Next → brightport_elyzard6

brightport_elyzard2 Three-fang-elyzard: “We thank you outsider. But not enough to repair our trust.”

  • Next → brightport_elyzard3

brightport_elyzard0_1 Three-fang-elyzard: “Our fangs hunger for retribution and our claws follow swiftly, we will not wait for long.”

brightport_elyzard0_0 Dummy NPC: “The lizard king's advisor interjects”

  • Next → brightport_elyzard0

brightport_lizardkingfight Three-fang-elyzard: “Despicable creature, you show your true self before us. Your days end!” — effects: faction “lizardman” set to -110, sets stage 118 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag), faction “lizardfight” set to -110

  • Next (if NOT reached stage 117 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_lizardfight

brightport_elyzard6 Three-fang-elyzard: “Our trust is given, what else do you wish to ask for.”

  • “Would you agree to trade Bryma the bones of animals you hunt?” (if reached stage 221 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_elyzard7
  • “Peace is enough.” → brightport_elyzard9

brightport_elyzard3 Three-fang-elyzard: “Speak with Dominio our Shadow chaplain, he will tell you the task.” — effects: sets stage 60 of The balance of scales

brightport_elyzard0 Tail-swing-tyliad: “Minion of the witch! From our burial chamber 13 bones of our ancestors were shamelessly stolen. Return them to us or we will return them ourselves.” — effects: sets stage 40 of The balance of scales

brightport_lizardfight (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken) — effects: spawns monsters on brightport_cave17, spawns monsters on brightport_cave17, spawns monsters on brightport_cave17, spawns monsters on brightport_lizard1, sets stage 117 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag), faction “lizardfight” set to -111, removes monsters from brightport_lizard3, removes monsters from brightport_lizard2, removes monsters from brightport_lizard3, removes monsters from brightport_lizard1, removes monsters from brightport_lizard1

  • Next (if NOT reached stage 118 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_lizardfight1_1
  • Next (if reached stage 118 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → brightport_lizardkingfight1

brightport_elyzard7 Three-fang-elyzard: “It is agreed. Now go and rest well, we welcome you.” — effects: sets stage 95 of The balance of scales

brightport_elyzard9 Three-fang-elyzard: “It is agreed. Now go and rest well, we welcome you.”

brightport_lizardfight1_1 Three-fang-elyzard: “As you make your way to the settlement, you freeze in your step, a loud hissing sound resounding in your ears.”

  • Next → brightport_lizardfight1

brightport_lizardkingfight1 (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 → fight starts

brightport_lizardfight1 Lizard warrior: “Your days end here, troublesome intruder!”

  • “I will polish my blade in your blood.” → conversation ends
  • “Is it too late to apologize?” → conversation ends
