  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Burhczyd: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

  • “Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.” → burhczydx_3a_6

burhczydx_2a_5 Burhczyd: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • “My pleasure.” → burhczydx_1a_9

burhczydx_14a_6 Burhczyd: “I now live as a monk. I rise at dawn, pray at noon, and reflect at night.”

  • “In a tavern?” → burhczydx_14a_7

burhczydx_13a_6 Burhczyd: “That is a detail. My bread will be larger. The largest ones far and wide.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_12a_6 Burhczyd: “Of all the options she has, she chooses a baker. Why? Why?”

  • “Hmm, a baker can bake bridecake.” → burhczydx_12a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Burhczyd: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

  • “You will marry?” → burhczydx_11a_7

burhczydx_10a_6 Burhczyd: “You know, once I feasted with the Lord Commander of the Order of Elythom. A very pleasant man.”

burhczydx_3a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Knight of Elythom: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Knight of Elythom: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Knight of Elythom: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Knight of Elythom: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Knight of Elythom: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Knight of Elythom: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Knight of Elythom: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Knight of Elythom: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Knight of Elythom: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Knight of Elythom: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Knight of Elythom: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Knight of Elythom: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Knight of Elythom: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Knight of Elythom: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

burhczydx_6a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

burhczydx_5a_5 Knight of Elythom: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “About trade? Or life?” → burhczydx_12a_3

  • “When we last met you were dressed like a knight of the Elythom.” → burhczydx_11a_3

burhczydx_10a_2 Knight of Elythom: “No, $playername. I have not seen Andor lately.”

  • “How do you know my name?” → burhczydx_10a_3

burhczydx_9a_2 Knight of Elythom: “I have a bad conscience.”

  • “Why? Did you do something wrong?” → burhczydx_9a_3

burhczydx_8a_2 Knight of Elythom: “Sure I did. And I also have learned a new profession. I am already rather good.”

  • “Great to hear! Tell me more.” → burhczydx_8a_3

burhczydx_7a_2 Knight of Elythom: “Yes. Sigh.”

  • “What's up with you?” → burhczydx_7a_3

burhczydx_6a_2 Knight of Elythom: “... WITH TEAAAAARS IN HER EYEEES ...”

  • “Oh dear - it is Burhczyd.” → burhczydx_6a_3

burhczydx_5a_2 Knight of Elythom: “Is it? Anyway. Nice to meet you here. I want to thank you for your good advice.”

  • “Oh, it is nothing.” → burhczydx_5a_3
  • “You really needed it.” → burhczydx_5a_3

burhczydx_4a_2 Knight of Elythom: “I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye, proud owner of Easy Transports.”

  • “The last time we saw each other, you did not have any transport orders yet.” → burhczydx_4a_3

burhczydx_3a_2 Knight of Elythom: “Don't ask. Still no orders. And I have no idea why.”

  • “That's horrible! What did you call your company? It should be short and memorable.” → burhczydx_3a_3

burhczydx_2a_2 Knight of Elythom: “Yes, almost: My name is Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. I opened a transport company, as you suggested.”

  • “Great to hear! Is it going well? Do you already have many customers?” → burhczydx_2a_3

burhczydx_1a_2 Knight of Elythom: “Cool. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. Nice to meet you.”

  • “Burh... - eh, OK. Do you live here in this town?” → burhczydx_1a_3

burhczydx_14a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Sigh. That was a long time ago. In a past life.”

  • “And the oven?” → burhczydx_14a_4

burhczydx_13a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Ah that. [patting the oven fondly] Destiny is heavy, and the table here is strong, that's why.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_4

burhczydx_12a_3 Knight of Elythom: “No. About mugs. They’re always empty when you need them most.”

  • “Oh, what's wrong with you?” → burhczydx_12a_4

burhczydx_11a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Eh ... yes, right.”

  • “I'm very curious about the story now. Tell me how have you been since we last met? What about the Elythom?” → burhczydx_11a_4

burhczydx_10a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Oops. Eh, well, we Elythom knights know many things.”

  • “That's not the whole truth. Now?” → burhczydx_10a_4

burhczydx_9a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Yes, I did something very wrong.”

  • Next → burhczydx_9a_4

burhczydx_8a_3 Knight of Elythom: “I talk to people in places like this. Taverns and such.”

  • “Yes. And...?” → burhczydx_8a_4

burhczydx_7a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Look here, my lute. The best instrument in the country. And I'm not allowed to play here.”

  • “Why not?” → burhczydx_7a_4

burhczydx_6a_3 Knight of Elythom: “... AAAAAAND IT WAS NIIIIGHT!”

  • “Finally. Bravo! More! But not now, please.” → burhczydx_6a_4

burhczydx_5a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Yes. Immediately after the burnt offering, I was able to complete a very profitable trade.”

  • “Indeed? Great!” → burhczydx_5a_4
  • “It's about time!” → burhczydx_5a_4

burhczydx_4a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.”

  • Next → burhczydx_4a_4

burhczydx_3a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Knight of Elythom: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Knight of Elythom: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Knight of Elythom: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Knight of Elythom: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Knight of Elythom: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Knight of Elythom: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Knight of Elythom: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Knight of Elythom: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Knight of Elythom: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Knight of Elythom: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Knight of Elythom: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Knight of Elythom: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Knight of Elythom: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Knight of Elythom: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

  • “Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.” → burhczydx_3a_6

burhczydx_2a_5 Knight of Elythom: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

burhczydx_1a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • “In a tavern?” → burhczydx_14a_7

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_12a_6 Knight of Elythom: “Of all the options she has, she chooses a baker. Why? Why?”

  • “Hmm, a baker can bake bridecake.” → burhczydx_12a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Knight of Elythom: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

  • “You will marry?” → burhczydx_11a_7

burhczydx_10a_6 Knight of Elythom: “You know, once I feasted with the Lord Commander of the Order of Elythom. A very pleasant man.”

  • “It's about time!” → burhczydx_5a_4

burhczydx_4a_3 Burhczyd: “Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.”

  • Next → burhczydx_4a_4

burhczydx_3a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Burhczyd: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Burhczyd: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_13a_2 Burhczyd: “Which oven?”

  • “Don't pretend. The oven is right in front of your nose.” → burhczydx_13a_3

burhczydx_12a_2 Burhczyd: “I’ve learned something important.”

  • “About trade? Or life?” → burhczydx_12a_3

burhczydx_11a_2 Burhczyd: “Hmm ... what?”

  • “When we last met you were dressed like a knight of the Elythom.” → burhczydx_11a_3

burhczydx_10a_2 Burhczyd: “No, $playername. I have not seen Andor lately.”

  • “How do you know my name?” → burhczydx_10a_3

burhczydx_9a_2 Burhczyd: “I have a bad conscience.”

  • “Why? Did you do something wrong?” → burhczydx_9a_3

burhczydx_8a_2 Burhczyd: “Sure I did. And I also have learned a new profession. I am already rather good.”

  • “Great to hear! Tell me more.” → burhczydx_8a_3

burhczydx_7a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes. Sigh.”

  • “What's up with you?” → burhczydx_7a_3

burhczydx_6a_2 Burhczyd: “... WITH TEAAAAARS IN HER EYEEES ...”

  • “Oh dear - it is Burhczyd.” → burhczydx_6a_3

burhczydx_5a_2 Burhczyd: “Is it? Anyway. Nice to meet you here. I want to thank you for your good advice.”

  • “Oh, it is nothing.” → burhczydx_5a_3
  • “You really needed it.” → burhczydx_5a_3

burhczydx_4a_2 Burhczyd: “I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye, proud owner of Easy Transports.”

  • “The last time we saw each other, you did not have any transport orders yet.” → burhczydx_4a_3

burhczydx_3a_2 Burhczyd: “Don't ask. Still no orders. And I have no idea why.”

  • “That's horrible! What did you call your company? It should be short and memorable.” → burhczydx_3a_3

burhczydx_2a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes, almost: My name is Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. I opened a transport company, as you suggested.”

  • “Great to hear! Is it going well? Do you already have many customers?” → burhczydx_2a_3

burhczydx_1a_2 Burhczyd: “Cool. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. Nice to meet you.”

  • “Burh... - eh, OK. Do you live here in this town?” → burhczydx_1a_3

burhczydx_14a_3 Burhczyd: “Sigh. That was a long time ago. In a past life.”

  • “And the oven?” → burhczydx_14a_4

burhczydx_13a_3 Burhczyd: “Ah that. [patting the oven fondly] Destiny is heavy, and the table here is strong, that's why.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_4

burhczydx_12a_3 Burhczyd: “No. About mugs. They’re always empty when you need them most.”

  • “Oh, what's wrong with you?” → burhczydx_12a_4

burhczydx_11a_3 Burhczyd: “Eh ... yes, right.”

  • “I'm very curious about the story now. Tell me how have you been since we last met? What about the Elythom?” → burhczydx_11a_4

burhczydx_10a_3 Burhczyd: “Oops. Eh, well, we Elythom knights know many things.”

  • “That's not the whole truth. Now?” → burhczydx_10a_4

burhczydx_9a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, I did something very wrong.”

  • Next → burhczydx_9a_4

burhczydx_8a_3 Burhczyd: “I talk to people in places like this. Taverns and such.”

  • “Yes. And...?” → burhczydx_8a_4

burhczydx_7a_3 Burhczyd: “Look here, my lute. The best instrument in the country. And I'm not allowed to play here.”

  • “Why not?” → burhczydx_7a_4

burhczydx_6a_3 Burhczyd: “... AAAAAAND IT WAS NIIIIGHT!”

  • “Finally. Bravo! More! But not now, please.” → burhczydx_6a_4

burhczydx_5a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. Immediately after the burnt offering, I was able to complete a very profitable trade.”

  • “Indeed? Great!” → burhczydx_5a_4
  • “It's about time!” → burhczydx_5a_4

burhczydx_4a_3 Burhczyd: “Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.”

  • Next → burhczydx_4a_4

burhczydx_3a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Burhczyd: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Burhczyd: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Burhczyd: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Burhczyd: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Burhczyd: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Burhczyd: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

  • “And the landlord was not amused?” → burhczydx_7a_6

burhczydx_6a_5 Burhczyd: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Burhczyd: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

  • “Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.” → burhczydx_3a_6

burhczydx_2a_5 Burhczyd: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

  • “Good grief! What did you name your company?!” → burhczydx_2a_6

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • “My pleasure.” → burhczydx_1a_9

burhczydx_14a_6 Burhczyd: “I now live as a monk. I rise at dawn, pray at noon, and reflect at night.”

  • “In a tavern?” → burhczydx_14a_7

burhczydx_13a_6 Burhczyd: “That is a detail. My bread will be larger. The largest ones far and wide.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_12a_6 Burhczyd: “Of all the options she has, she chooses a baker. Why? Why?”

  • “Hmm, a baker can bake bridecake.” → burhczydx_12a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Burhczyd: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

  • “You will marry?” → burhczydx_11a_7

burhczydx_10a_6 Burhczyd: “You know, once I feasted with the Lord Commander of the Order of Elythom. A very pleasant man.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6a

burhczydx_3a_4 Knight of Elythom: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Knight of Elythom: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Knight of Elythom: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Knight of Elythom: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Knight of Elythom: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Knight of Elythom: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Knight of Elythom: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

burhczydx_6a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Knight of Elythom: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Knight of Elythom: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

burhczydx_3a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

burhczydx_2a_5 Knight of Elythom: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

burhczydx_1a_5 Knight of Elythom: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Burhczyd: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

burhczydx_9a_5 Burhczyd: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

burhczydx_13a_2 Burhczyd: “Which oven?”

  • “Don't pretend. The oven is right in front of your nose.” → burhczydx_13a_3

burhczydx_12a_2 Burhczyd: “I’ve learned something important.”

  • “About trade? Or life?” → burhczydx_12a_3

burhczydx_11a_2 Burhczyd: “Hmm ... what?”

  • “When we last met you were dressed like a knight of the Elythom.” → burhczydx_11a_3

burhczydx_10a_2 Burhczyd: “No, $playername. I have not seen Andor lately.”

  • “How do you know my name?” → burhczydx_10a_3

burhczydx_9a_2 Burhczyd: “I have a bad conscience.”

  • “Why? Did you do something wrong?” → burhczydx_9a_3

burhczydx_8a_2 Burhczyd: “Sure I did. And I also have learned a new profession. I am already rather good.”

  • “Great to hear! Tell me more.” → burhczydx_8a_3

burhczydx_7a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes. Sigh.”

  • “What's up with you?” → burhczydx_7a_3

burhczydx_6a_2 Burhczyd: “... WITH TEAAAAARS IN HER EYEEES ...”

  • “Oh dear - it is Burhczyd.” → burhczydx_6a_3

burhczydx_5a_2 Burhczyd: “Is it? Anyway. Nice to meet you here. I want to thank you for your good advice.”

  • “Oh, it is nothing.” → burhczydx_5a_3
  • “You really needed it.” → burhczydx_5a_3

burhczydx_4a_2 Burhczyd: “I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye, proud owner of Easy Transports.”

  • “The last time we saw each other, you did not have any transport orders yet.” → burhczydx_4a_3

burhczydx_3a_2 Burhczyd: “Don't ask. Still no orders. And I have no idea why.”

  • “That's horrible! What did you call your company? It should be short and memorable.” → burhczydx_3a_3

burhczydx_2a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes, almost: My name is Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. I opened a transport company, as you suggested.”

  • “Great to hear! Is it going well? Do you already have many customers?” → burhczydx_2a_3

burhczydx_1a_2 Burhczyd: “Cool. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. Nice to meet you.”

  • “Burh... - eh, OK. Do you live here in this town?” → burhczydx_1a_3

burhczydx_14a_3 Burhczyd: “Sigh. That was a long time ago. In a past life.”

  • “And the oven?” → burhczydx_14a_4

burhczydx_13a_3 Burhczyd: “Ah that. [patting the oven fondly] Destiny is heavy, and the table here is strong, that's why.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_4

burhczydx_12a_3 Burhczyd: “No. About mugs. They’re always empty when you need them most.”

  • “Oh, what's wrong with you?” → burhczydx_12a_4

burhczydx_11a_3 Burhczyd: “Eh ... yes, right.”

  • “I'm very curious about the story now. Tell me how have you been since we last met? What about the Elythom?” → burhczydx_11a_4

burhczydx_10a_3 Burhczyd: “Oops. Eh, well, we Elythom knights know many things.”

  • “That's not the whole truth. Now?” → burhczydx_10a_4

burhczydx_9a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, I did something very wrong.”

  • Next → burhczydx_9a_4

burhczydx_8a_3 Burhczyd: “I talk to people in places like this. Taverns and such.”

  • “Yes. And...?” → burhczydx_8a_4

burhczydx_7a_3 Burhczyd: “Look here, my lute. The best instrument in the country. And I'm not allowed to play here.”

  • “Why not?” → burhczydx_7a_4

burhczydx_6a_3 Burhczyd: “... AAAAAAND IT WAS NIIIIGHT!”

  • “Finally. Bravo! More! But not now, please.” → burhczydx_6a_4

burhczydx_5a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. Immediately after the burnt offering, I was able to complete a very profitable trade.”

  • “Indeed? Great!” → burhczydx_5a_4
  • “It's about time!” → burhczydx_5a_4

burhczydx_4a_3 Burhczyd: “Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.”

  • Next → burhczydx_4a_4

burhczydx_3a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Burhczyd: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Burhczyd: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Burhczyd: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Burhczyd: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Burhczyd: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Burhczyd: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

  • “And the landlord was not amused?” → burhczydx_7a_6

burhczydx_6a_5 Burhczyd: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Burhczyd: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

  • “Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.” → burhczydx_3a_6

burhczydx_2a_5 Burhczyd: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

  • “Good grief! What did you name your company?!” → burhczydx_2a_6

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • “My pleasure.” → burhczydx_1a_9

burhczydx_14a_6 Burhczyd: “I now live as a monk. I rise at dawn, pray at noon, and reflect at night.”

  • “In a tavern?” → burhczydx_14a_7

burhczydx_13a_6 Burhczyd: “That is a detail. My bread will be larger. The largest ones far and wide.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_12a_6 Burhczyd: “Of all the options she has, she chooses a baker. Why? Why?”

  • “Hmm, a baker can bake bridecake.” → burhczydx_12a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Burhczyd: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

  • “You will marry?” → burhczydx_11a_7

burhczydx_10a_6 Burhczyd: “You know, once I feasted with the Lord Commander of the Order of Elythom. A very pleasant man.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6a

  • “Oh, what's wrong with you?” → burhczydx_12a_4

  • “That's not the whole truth. Now?” → burhczydx_10a_4

burhczydx_9a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, I did something very wrong.”

  • Next → burhczydx_9a_4

burhczydx_8a_3 Burhczyd: “I talk to people in places like this. Taverns and such.”

  • “Yes. And...?” → burhczydx_8a_4

burhczydx_7a_3 Burhczyd: “Look here, my lute. The best instrument in the country. And I'm not allowed to play here.”

  • “Why not?” → burhczydx_7a_4

burhczydx_6a_3 Burhczyd: “... AAAAAAND IT WAS NIIIIGHT!”

  • “Finally. Bravo! More! But not now, please.” → burhczydx_6a_4

burhczydx_5a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. Immediately after the burnt offering, I was able to complete a very profitable trade.”

  • “Indeed? Great!” → burhczydx_5a_4
  • “It's about time!” → burhczydx_5a_4

burhczydx_4a_3 Burhczyd: “Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.”

  • Next → burhczydx_4a_4

burhczydx_3a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Burhczyd: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Burhczyd: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Burhczyd: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

burhczydx_6a_5 Burhczyd: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Burhczyd: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

burhczydx_2a_3 Burhczyd: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Burhczyd: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Burhczyd: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Burhczyd: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Burhczyd: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Burhczyd: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

  • “And the landlord was not amused?” → burhczydx_7a_6

burhczydx_6a_5 Burhczyd: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Burhczyd: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

  • “Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.” → burhczydx_3a_6

burhczydx_2a_5 Burhczyd: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

  • “Good grief! What did you name your company?!” → burhczydx_2a_6

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • “My pleasure.” → burhczydx_1a_9

burhczydx_14a_6 Burhczyd: “I now live as a monk. I rise at dawn, pray at noon, and reflect at night.”

  • “In a tavern?” → burhczydx_14a_7

burhczydx_13a_6 Burhczyd: “That is a detail. My bread will be larger. The largest ones far and wide.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_12a_6 Burhczyd: “Of all the options she has, she chooses a baker. Why? Why?”

  • “Hmm, a baker can bake bridecake.” → burhczydx_12a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Burhczyd: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

  • “You will marry?” → burhczydx_11a_7

burhczydx_10a_6 Burhczyd: “You know, once I feasted with the Lord Commander of the Order of Elythom. A very pleasant man.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6a

  • “You are really unlucky.” → burhczydx_7a_7

burhczydx_3a_6 Burhczyd: “OK, thank you. I'll try. Later. Tomorrow. Maybe. (sob)”

burhczydx_13a_2 Burhczyd: “Which oven?”

  • “Don't pretend. The oven is right in front of your nose.” → burhczydx_13a_3

burhczydx_12a_2 Burhczyd: “I’ve learned something important.”

  • “About trade? Or life?” → burhczydx_12a_3

burhczydx_11a_2 Burhczyd: “Hmm ... what?”

  • “When we last met you were dressed like a knight of the Elythom.” → burhczydx_11a_3

burhczydx_10a_2 Burhczyd: “No, $playername. I have not seen Andor lately.”

  • “How do you know my name?” → burhczydx_10a_3

burhczydx_9a_2 Burhczyd: “I have a bad conscience.”

  • “Why? Did you do something wrong?” → burhczydx_9a_3

burhczydx_8a_2 Burhczyd: “Sure I did. And I also have learned a new profession. I am already rather good.”

  • “Great to hear! Tell me more.” → burhczydx_8a_3

burhczydx_7a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes. Sigh.”

  • “What's up with you?” → burhczydx_7a_3

burhczydx_6a_2 Burhczyd: “... WITH TEAAAAARS IN HER EYEEES ...”

  • “Oh dear - it is Burhczyd.” → burhczydx_6a_3

burhczydx_5a_2 Burhczyd: “Is it? Anyway. Nice to meet you here. I want to thank you for your good advice.”

  • “Oh, it is nothing.” → burhczydx_5a_3
  • “You really needed it.” → burhczydx_5a_3

burhczydx_4a_2 Burhczyd: “I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye, proud owner of Easy Transports.”

  • “The last time we saw each other, you did not have any transport orders yet.” → burhczydx_4a_3

burhczydx_3a_2 Burhczyd: “Don't ask. Still no orders. And I have no idea why.”

  • “That's horrible! What did you call your company? It should be short and memorable.” → burhczydx_3a_3

burhczydx_2a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes, almost: My name is Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. I opened a transport company, as you suggested.”

  • “Great to hear! Is it going well? Do you already have many customers?” → burhczydx_2a_3

burhczydx_1a_2 Burhczyd: “Cool. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. Nice to meet you.”

  • “Burh... - eh, OK. Do you live here in this town?” → burhczydx_1a_3

burhczydx_14a_3 Burhczyd: “Sigh. That was a long time ago. In a past life.”

  • “And the oven?” → burhczydx_14a_4

burhczydx_13a_3 Burhczyd: “Ah that. [patting the oven fondly] Destiny is heavy, and the table here is strong, that's why.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_4

burhczydx_12a_3 Burhczyd: “No. About mugs. They’re always empty when you need them most.”

  • “Oh, what's wrong with you?” → burhczydx_12a_4

burhczydx_11a_3 Burhczyd: “Eh ... yes, right.”

  • “I'm very curious about the story now. Tell me how have you been since we last met? What about the Elythom?” → burhczydx_11a_4

burhczydx_10a_3 Burhczyd: “Oops. Eh, well, we Elythom knights know many things.”

  • “That's not the whole truth. Now?” → burhczydx_10a_4

burhczydx_9a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, I did something very wrong.”

  • Next → burhczydx_9a_4

burhczydx_8a_3 Burhczyd: “I talk to people in places like this. Taverns and such.”

  • “Yes. And...?” → burhczydx_8a_4

burhczydx_7a_3 Burhczyd: “Look here, my lute. The best instrument in the country. And I'm not allowed to play here.”

  • “Why not?” → burhczydx_7a_4

burhczydx_6a_3 Burhczyd: “... AAAAAAND IT WAS NIIIIGHT!”

  • “Finally. Bravo! More! But not now, please.” → burhczydx_6a_4

burhczydx_5a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. Immediately after the burnt offering, I was able to complete a very profitable trade.”

  • “Indeed? Great!” → burhczydx_5a_4
  • “It's about time!” → burhczydx_5a_4

burhczydx_4a_3 Burhczyd: “Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.”

  • Next → burhczydx_4a_4

burhczydx_3a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Burhczyd: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Burhczyd: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Burhczyd: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Burhczyd: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Burhczyd: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Burhczyd: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

  • “And the landlord was not amused?” → burhczydx_7a_6

burhczydx_6a_5 Burhczyd: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Burhczyd: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

  • “Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.” → burhczydx_3a_6

burhczydx_2a_5 Burhczyd: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

  • “Good grief! What did you name your company?!” → burhczydx_2a_6

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • “My pleasure.” → burhczydx_1a_9

burhczydx_14a_6 Burhczyd: “I now live as a monk. I rise at dawn, pray at noon, and reflect at night.”

  • “In a tavern?” → burhczydx_14a_7

burhczydx_13a_6 Burhczyd: “That is a detail. My bread will be larger. The largest ones far and wide.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_12a_6 Burhczyd: “Of all the options she has, she chooses a baker. Why? Why?”

  • “Hmm, a baker can bake bridecake.” → burhczydx_12a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Burhczyd: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

  • “You will marry?” → burhczydx_11a_7

burhczydx_10a_6 Burhczyd: “You know, once I feasted with the Lord Commander of the Order of Elythom. A very pleasant man.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6a

  • “You are really unlucky.” → burhczydx_7a_7

burhczydx_6a_5b Burhczyd: “Eh, wait. Do you have any idea why the landlord is coming for me with a thick wooden club?”

  • “It's probably best that you promise him that you will not sing anymore.” → burhczydx_6a_6

  • “Ah. OK, but what do you intend to use to transport the next load?” → burhczydx_5a_7

burhczydx_4a_6 Burhczyd: “Of course from Remgard, their fish is the best - a rare delicacy in this area!”

  • “Rare yes, but still delicious?” → burhczydx_4a_7

burhczydx_3a_6 Burhczyd: “OK, thank you. I'll try. Later. Tomorrow. Maybe. (sob)”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_9

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Burhczyd: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Burhczyd: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Burhczyd: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Burhczyd: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

  • “And the landlord was not amused?” → burhczydx_7a_6

burhczydx_6a_5 Burhczyd: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Burhczyd: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

burhczydx_10a_2 Burhczyd: “No, $playername. I have not seen Andor lately.”

  • “How do you know my name?” → burhczydx_10a_3

burhczydx_9a_2 Burhczyd: “I have a bad conscience.”

  • “Why? Did you do something wrong?” → burhczydx_9a_3

burhczydx_8a_2 Burhczyd: “Sure I did. And I also have learned a new profession. I am already rather good.”

  • “Great to hear! Tell me more.” → burhczydx_8a_3

burhczydx_7a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes. Sigh.”

  • “What's up with you?” → burhczydx_7a_3

burhczydx_6a_2 Burhczyd: “... WITH TEAAAAARS IN HER EYEEES ...”

  • “Oh dear - it is Burhczyd.” → burhczydx_6a_3

burhczydx_5a_2 Burhczyd: “Is it? Anyway. Nice to meet you here. I want to thank you for your good advice.”

  • “Oh, it is nothing.” → burhczydx_5a_3
  • “You really needed it.” → burhczydx_5a_3

burhczydx_4a_2 Burhczyd: “I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye, proud owner of Easy Transports.”

  • “The last time we saw each other, you did not have any transport orders yet.” → burhczydx_4a_3

burhczydx_3a_2 Burhczyd: “Don't ask. Still no orders. And I have no idea why.”

  • “That's horrible! What did you call your company? It should be short and memorable.” → burhczydx_3a_3

burhczydx_2a_2 Burhczyd: “Yes, almost: My name is Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. I opened a transport company, as you suggested.”

  • “Great to hear! Is it going well? Do you already have many customers?” → burhczydx_2a_3

burhczydx_1a_2 Burhczyd: “Cool. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. Nice to meet you.”

  • “Burh... - eh, OK. Do you live here in this town?” → burhczydx_1a_3

burhczydx_14a_3 Burhczyd: “Sigh. That was a long time ago. In a past life.”

  • “And the oven?” → burhczydx_14a_4

burhczydx_13a_3 Burhczyd: “Ah that. [patting the oven fondly] Destiny is heavy, and the table here is strong, that's why.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_4

burhczydx_12a_3 Burhczyd: “No. About mugs. They’re always empty when you need them most.”

  • “Oh, what's wrong with you?” → burhczydx_12a_4

burhczydx_11a_3 Burhczyd: “Eh ... yes, right.”

  • “I'm very curious about the story now. Tell me how have you been since we last met? What about the Elythom?” → burhczydx_11a_4

burhczydx_10a_3 Burhczyd: “Oops. Eh, well, we Elythom knights know many things.”

  • “That's not the whole truth. Now?” → burhczydx_10a_4

burhczydx_9a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, I did something very wrong.”

  • Next → burhczydx_9a_4

burhczydx_8a_3 Burhczyd: “I talk to people in places like this. Taverns and such.”

  • “Yes. And...?” → burhczydx_8a_4

burhczydx_7a_3 Burhczyd: “Look here, my lute. The best instrument in the country. And I'm not allowed to play here.”

  • “Why not?” → burhczydx_7a_4

burhczydx_6a_3 Burhczyd: “... AAAAAAND IT WAS NIIIIGHT!”

  • “Finally. Bravo! More! But not now, please.” → burhczydx_6a_4

burhczydx_5a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. Immediately after the burnt offering, I was able to complete a very profitable trade.”

  • “Indeed? Great!” → burhczydx_5a_4
  • “It's about time!” → burhczydx_5a_4

burhczydx_4a_3 Burhczyd: “Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.”

  • Next → burhczydx_4a_4

burhczydx_3a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?”

  • Next → burhczydx_3a_4

burhczydx_2a_3 Burhczyd: “Well, there are not too many yet.”

  • Next → burhczydx_2a_4

burhczydx_1a_3 Burhczyd: “Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.”

  • “Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.” → burhczydx_1a_4

burhczydx_14a_4 Burhczyd: “Sold.”

  • “A good decision, I think. Was it profitable?” → burhczydx_14a_5

burhczydx_13a_4 Burhczyd: “She is to marry a baker.”

  • “So you had mentioned.” → burhczydx_13a_5

burhczydx_12a_4 Burhczyd: “She is marrying a baker.”

  • “Who are you talking about?” → burhczydx_12a_5

burhczydx_11a_4 Burhczyd: “Oh that. I got bored playing Knight of the Elythom. I then spread the word that I was walking around dressed as one.”

  • Next → burhczydx_11a_5

burhczydx_10a_4 Burhczyd: “All right, $playername. Of course I know you well. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye.”

  • “Burhczyd? You - a Knight of Elythom?” → burhczydx_10a_5

burhczydx_9a_4 Burhczyd: “I never should have done that to a friend.”

  • “What do you mean?” → burhczydx_9a_5

burhczydx_8a_4 Burhczyd: “We talk about everything; the world, magic rings, dragons, everything. We become more and more familiar.”

  • “And by doing that you get a beer or two?” → burhczydx_8a_5

burhczydx_7a_4 Burhczyd: “I played so well and charmingly, that the guests forgot everything around them.”

  • “But that is great!” → burhczydx_7a_5

burhczydx_6a_4 Burhczyd: “Hey, my biggest fan. How did you find me?”

  • “You were incredible.” → burhczydx_6a_5
  • “Easy, just follow the noise.” → burhczydx_6a_5

burhczydx_5a_4 Burhczyd: “Just look at this heavy bag of gold!”

  • “I am very impressed. What was the trade?” → burhczydx_5a_5

burhczydx_4a_4 Burhczyd: “I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.”

  • “Fish?” → burhczydx_4a_5

burhczydx_3a_4 Burhczyd: “It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!”

  • “You can't be serious! BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!” → burhczydx_3a_5

burhczydx_2a_4 Burhczyd: “More precisely, none at all.”

  • “Really? Why is this?” → burhczydx_2a_5

burhczydx_1a_4 Burhczyd: “What are you talking about?”

  • “Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.” → burhczydx_1a_5

burhczydx_14a_5 Burhczyd: “Spiritually. [He folds his hands.] I have cast aside worldly burdens.”

  • Next → burhczydx_14a_6

burhczydx_13a_5 Burhczyd: “Thus I, too, have become a baker. So easy.”

  • “You own no house. How will you do it?” → burhczydx_13a_6

burhczydx_12a_5 Burhczyd: “Who am I talking about? WHO AM I TALKING ABOUT??”

  • “Eh ... Oh. Your love. I see.” → burhczydx_12a_6

burhczydx_11a_5 Burhczyd: “They are still searching and now suspect each other! Extremely amusing!”

  • “No really! You are impossible” → burhczydx_11a_6

burhczydx_10a_5 Burhczyd: “One should have that impression. But not everything is as it seems.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6

burhczydx_9a_5 Burhczyd: “I 'borrowed' some things from you the last time we met.”

  • “Did you? I can't recall.” → burhczydx_9a_6

burhczydx_8a_5 Burhczyd: “Ha ha ha. Much better. People start to trust me. A great feeling.”

  • Next → burhczydx_8a_5_81

burhczydx_7a_5 Burhczyd: “They even forgot to order something to drink.”

  • “And the landlord was not amused?” → burhczydx_7a_6

burhczydx_6a_5 Burhczyd: “Thank you, I know. What is your name again?”

  • “$playername. Is my name that difficult?” → burhczydx_6a_5b

burhczydx_5a_5 Burhczyd: “It was a very simple thing. Fast and easy gold.”

  • “Tell me, what was the trade for?” → burhczydx_5a_6

burhczydx_4a_5 Burhczyd: “In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.”

  • “Fresh fish - from Remgard?” → burhczydx_4a_6

burhczydx_3a_5 Burhczyd: “Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)”

  • “Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.” → burhczydx_3a_6

burhczydx_2a_5 Burhczyd: “I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.”

  • “Good grief! What did you name your company?!” → burhczydx_2a_6

burhczydx_1a_5 Burhczyd: “Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.”

  • “My pleasure.” → burhczydx_1a_9

burhczydx_14a_6 Burhczyd: “I now live as a monk. I rise at dawn, pray at noon, and reflect at night.”

  • “In a tavern?” → burhczydx_14a_7

burhczydx_13a_6 Burhczyd: “That is a detail. My bread will be larger. The largest ones far and wide.”

  • Next → burhczydx_13a_7

burhczydx_12a_6 Burhczyd: “Of all the options she has, she chooses a baker. Why? Why?”

  • “Hmm, a baker can bake bridecake.” → burhczydx_12a_7

burhczydx_11a_6 Burhczyd: “And now I will lead a serious and decent life. I owe that to my bride-to-be.”

  • “You will marry?” → burhczydx_11a_7

burhczydx_10a_6 Burhczyd: “You know, once I feasted with the Lord Commander of the Order of Elythom. A very pleasant man.”

  • Next → burhczydx_10a_6a

Dialogue (33 lines)

What the dialogue says, exactly as in the game files. Lines are listed once; links jump to the line a choice leads to.

caeda (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if NOT reached stage 10 of The roots of love) → caeda_1
  • branch 2 (if reached stage 10 of The roots of love; NOT reached stage 20 of The roots of love; NOT reached stage 10 of A secret garden) → caeda_2
  • branch 3 (if reached stage 20 of The roots of love; NOT reached stage 10 of A secret garden) → caeda_3
  • branch 4 (if reached stage 60 of A secret garden) → caeda_60
  • branch 5 (if reached stage 50 of A secret garden) → caeda_50
  • branch 6 (if reached stage 40 of A secret garden) → caeda_40
  • branch 7 (if reached stage 30 of A secret garden) → caeda_30
  • branch 8 (if reached stage 20 of A secret garden) → caeda_20
  • branch 9 (if reached stage 10 of A secret garden) → caeda_10
  • branch 10 (if reached stage 40 of A secret garden; NOT reached stage 50 of A secret garden) → caeda_root30_1
  • “I killed most of the trolls in the cave.” (if reached stage 60 of A secret garden) → caeda_root60_1

caeda_1 Caeda: “So much work to do. I sure hope we will have some rain soon.”

caeda_2 Caeda: “So much work to do. I sure hope we will have some rain soon.”

  • “Do you know where I can find some damerilias?” → caeda_root10_0

caeda_3 Caeda: “Oh, it is you again.”

  • “Thank you for the damerilias.” → caeda_root10_5

caeda_60 Caeda: “Oh, it is you again. Thank you for all you have done.”

  • “Could you give me the key for the glade again?” (if reached stage 30 of The roots of love; NOT reached stage 205 of stn_nondisplay (hidden flag)) → caeda_root60_1
  • “No problem.” → conversation ends
  • “It was all for the Shadow.” → conversation ends

caeda_50 (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken)

  • branch 1 (if reached stage 55 of A secret garden) → caeda_root50_3
  • branch 2 → caeda_root50_2

caeda_40 Caeda: “Oh, it is you again. Thank you again for bringing back my key.”

  • Next → caeda_root40_1

caeda_30 Caeda: “Oh, it is you again. Did you find my key?”

  • “Yes. Here. Please take it.” (if hand over 1× Key to the glade) → caeda_root30_1
  • “Yes. Eh, no. I seem to have lost it. Wait, I'll go and find it.” → conversation ends

caeda_20 Caeda: “Oh, it is you. Nice to meet you again.”

caeda_10 Caeda: “Oh, it is you again. Did you find my key?”

  • “No, not yet.” → conversation ends

caeda_root30_1 Caeda: “You really found my key! Thank you - I can't believe it!” — effects: sets stage 40 of A secret garden

  • “A troll had taken the key, but he won't need it any more.” → caeda_root40_1

caeda_root60_1 Caeda: “Yes, of course. I will give you my father's key. Keep it. Then you can always pick damerilias for Noraed's grave.”

  • “That would be great, thank you.” → caeda_root60_2

caeda_root10_0 Caeda: “What a strange request!”

  • Next → caeda_root10_1

caeda_root10_5 Caeda: “These damerilias are not really good any more. You should get fresh ones from my family's glade north of Remgard.”

  • “How would I get to your glade?” → caeda_root10_6

caeda_root50_3 Caeda: “Is the passage to the glade safe again?”

  • “Yes, I have dealt with most of the trolls. They won't dare to bother you for a long time.” → caeda_root50_4

caeda_root50_2 Caeda: “Is the passage to the glade safe again?”

  • “No, not yet. I guess there are at least 30 trolls to kill. I will go after them again.” → caeda_root50_2a

caeda_root40_1 Caeda: “With all these trolls around I don't feel safe to go through the cave and take care of the flowers in the glade.”

  • Next → caeda_root40_1a

caeda_root60_2 Caeda: “Here is the key. I will move to the glade and retire there. It is the most beautiful place in the world.” — effects: sets stage 205 of stn_nondisplay (hidden flag), removes monsters from remgard0, spawns monsters on lakecave2, gives 1× Key to the glade, removes monsters from lakecave2

  • “So I will meet you there. Bye.” → NPC leaves

caeda_root10_1 Caeda: “Yes I happen to have some. Why are you asking?”

  • “There is this woman in Stoutford, she wants some for the grave of her husband, Noraed.” → caeda_root10_2

caeda_root10_6 Caeda: “To find the glade you have to pass through a cave. There are trolls, but my father had put up a statue that the trolls don't like to pass. So I was able to pass through the cave fairly safely.”

  • Next → caeda_root10_6a

caeda_root50_4 Caeda: “Thank you so much! I wish you safe travels back to Stoutford. If you want to go to the glade next time you are in Remgard, just ask me for the key.” — effects: sets stage 60 of A secret garden

  • “Thank you. I will leave now.” → conversation ends

caeda_root50_2a Caeda: “Please do, and come to me when you are done with them.”

caeda_root40_1a Caeda: “The scorpions are bad enough, but the trolls are really dangerous. I know that they hate the statue, but I am scared they can reach past it.”

  • Next → caeda_root40_2

caeda_root10_2 Caeda: “Noraed is dead? Oh no ... my poor little brother. What happened?”

  • “He was killed saving the life of his wife, during a monster attack on Stoutford.” → caeda_root10_3

caeda_root10_6a Caeda: “The glade itself is barred by a solid door to keep the trolls out. I had a key for it of course.”

  • “Had?” → caeda_root10_7

caeda_root40_2 Caeda: “Would it be too much to ask if you could get rid of the trolls?” — effects: sets stage 50 of A secret garden, spawns monsters on lakecave0

  • “I can teach them to stay further away from the statue. No problem.” → conversation ends

caeda_root10_3 Caeda: “Yes, that would be him. He loved Aryfora so much. I never had the chance to meet her.”

  • Next → caeda_root10_3a

caeda_root10_7 Caeda: “Yes. Unfortunately I did not pay enough attention to where I was going when I was there last time, and took a wrong turn.”

  • Next → caeda_root10_8

caeda_root10_3a Caeda: “Every year he came to pick the most beautiful damerilia to give it to her as a present.”

  • “Yes, Aryfora told me. She asked me to bring her some damerilias for Noraed's grave.” → caeda_root10_4

caeda_root10_8 Caeda: “Suddenly there were trolls everywhere. I barely escaped, but I must have lost the key to our glade there. If only I could have my key back!” — effects: sets stage 10 of A secret garden

  • “Your damerilias do look a bit wilted. I will go to your glade.” → caeda_root10_9
  • “Eh, OK. This isn't worth the trouble. Fresh damerilias wouldn't look different after my travel back. Thank you, I will…” → caeda_root10_8a

caeda_root10_4 Caeda: “I still have some. Here, take these to her, and send her my condolences.” — effects: gives 3× Damerilias, sets stage 20 of The roots of love

  • “Thanks. I'll make sure she gets them.” → caeda_root10_5
  • “All this trouble for a bunch of smelly flowers...” → caeda_root10_5

caeda_root10_9 Caeda: “And you will bring back my key to the glade? Then I would be the happiest person!”

  • “A small thing for me.” → conversation ends

caeda_root10_8a Caeda: “Farewell then. Give my greetings to my sister-in-law.” — effects: sets stage 20 of A secret garden
