  • branch 7 → zuul_khan_10

zuul_khan_155 Zuul'khan: “Don't disturb me! I am practicing dangerous spells.”

zuul_khan_150 Dummy NPC: “Zuul'khan towers over you and starts muttering strange words.”

  • “I'm feeling dizzy...” → zuul_khan_150_10

zuul_khan_115_10 Zuul'khan: “Bogsten is dead. Finally.”

  • “Yes. Now where is my reward?” → zuul_khan_115_20

zuul_khan_115 Zuul'khan: “Is Bogsten dead already?”

  • “No, not yet.” → conversation ends
  • “I have killed him.” (if killed 1× Bogsten) → zuul_khan_115_10

zuul_khan_70 Zuul'khan: “I see that you have their family necklace. So you must die now.”

  • “I'll have to thank Bogsten: This sounds like a fun fight.” → zuul_khan_70_24
  • “You shouldn't kill me. I could be of use.” → zuul_khan_70_84
  • “Please. I will crawl before you. Don't hurt me.” → zuul_khan_70_82

zuul_khan_10 Zuul'khan: “Oh kid, you look like someone nice. I don't want you to be injured because of me. I urge you to leave!”

  • “What's going on?” → zuul_khan_12

zuul_khan_150_10 Zuul'khan: “Done. You will never fear any of these fungi spores anymore.” — effects: sets stage 155 of Fungi panic, applies condition spore_poison, +1 Spore poison immunity

  • “Oh wow.” → zuul_khan_150_20

zuul_khan_115_20 Zuul'khan: “Give me the staff first.”

  • “Here it is.” (if hand over 1× Bogsten's staff) → zuul_khan_115_50
  • “Here it is.” (if wearing (and give up) Bogsten's staff) → zuul_khan_115_50
  • “No, I have changed my mind. I'll rather keep Bogsten's staff.” → zuul_khan_115_22

zuul_khan_70_24 Zuul'khan: “Then our little conversation is over now.”

  • “Attack!” → zuul_khan_70_30
  • “Hm, wait. Let me think again.” → zuul_khan_70_20
  • “I wish we could talk a little more.” → zuul_khan_50

zuul_khan_70_84 Zuul'khan: “Hmm. Maybe.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_70_20

zuul_khan_70_82 Zuul'khan: “Disgusting. Away with you!”

zuul_khan_12 Zuul'khan: “Give me your hand! ... No don't! ... Give me ...”

  • Next → zuul_khan_14

zuul_khan_150_20 Zuul'khan: “Leave me now! I have to regain my practice of spells.”

zuul_khan_115_50 Zuul'khan: “Finally I got the staff back!” — effects: sets stage 150 of Fungi panic

  • “My reward...?” → zuul_khan_150

zuul_khan_115_22 Zuul'khan: “You won't betray me, you little fool!”

  • “Who is betraying here? Where is my dearly earned reward!” → zuul_khan_115_20
  • “Little in height - but strong! Attack!” → zuul_khan_115_24

zuul_khan_70_30 (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken) — effects: sets stage 80 of Fungi panic

  • branch 1 → fight starts

zuul_khan_70_20 Zuul'khan: “Go and kill Bogsten up there.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_70_22

zuul_khan_50 Zuul'khan: “You may have a last wish. What do you want?”

  • “Tell me why you are here in Bogsten's caves?” → zuul_khan_60

zuul_khan_14 Zuul'khan: “I'm hurt ... I'll hurt ... Never do! ... Help! ... Kill! ... your hand - pleease ...”

  • “ Reach out your hand ” → zuul_khan_20
  • “Attack!” → zuul_khan_16
  • “I better go.” → conversation ends

zuul_khan_115_24 (silent check: the first matching branch below is taken) — effects: sets stage 135 of Fungi panic

  • branch 1 → fight starts

zuul_khan_70_22 Zuul'khan: “Kill Bogsten and bring me his staff as evidence.” — effects: sets stage 72 of Fungi panic

  • “What would I gain from this?” → zuul_khan_70_40
  • “No. I'd rather kill you.” → zuul_khan_70_24

zuul_khan_60 Zuul'khan: “Bogsten's cave? Oh how I hate that name!”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_20

zuul_khan_20 Zuul'khan: “Hahaha! AHAHAHAHA! I am free again!”

  • “Who are you?” → zuul_khan_30
  • “What are you?” → zuul_khan_22

zuul_khan_16 Zuul'khan: “No! Don't do me wrong!”

  • Next → zuul_khan_12

zuul_khan_70_40 Zuul'khan: “Ah. You are not as stupid as you look, kid.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_70_42

zuul_khan_60_20 Zuul'khan: “It was the Bogstens who imprisoned me here, long years ago. With a petrifying spell. I did nothing evil to them, except ... Well, I did almost nothing evil to them.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_30

zuul_khan_30 Zuul'khan: “I am the Archmancer of the underground. Widely known as Master of the Fungi and Commander to anything that crawls.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_32

zuul_khan_22 Zuul'khan: “Be nice, kid.”

  • “OK. Who are you?” → zuul_khan_30

zuul_khan_70_42 Zuul'khan: “I'll give you two things.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_70_44

zuul_khan_60_30 Zuul'khan: “More than a century ago, I found the way to command the crawling species of the underground and to bend the fungi to my will.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_40

zuul_khan_32 Zuul'khan: “I am the great Zuul'khan!”

  • “Great.” → zuul_khan_34

zuul_khan_70_44 Zuul'khan: “I'll spare your life.”

  • “Generously.” → zuul_khan_70_46

zuul_khan_60_40 Zuul'khan: “I chose this place to practice my arts and prepare an army of Fungi.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_50

zuul_khan_34 Zuul'khan: “Great and strong, yes.”

  • “Aha.” → zuul_khan_40

zuul_khan_70_46 Zuul'khan: “And I'll provide you with a permanent immunity to the spore poison.”

  • “Agreed. I'll go upstairs and finish Bogsten.” → zuul_khan_70_50
  • “Forget it. Attack!” → zuul_khan_70_30

zuul_khan_60_50 Zuul'khan: “The Bogstens must have heard about my activities in the caves under their house and became suspicious.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_60

zuul_khan_40 Zuul'khan: “You are the first human I've seen in such a long time.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_42

zuul_khan_70_50 Zuul'khan: “Do so.” — effects: sets stage 115 of Fungi panic

zuul_khan_60_60 Zuul'khan: “Lotho Bogsten sneaked down here and caught me unawares.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_70

zuul_khan_42 Zuul'khan: “And I am the last human you will ever see.”

  • “You threaten me?” → zuul_khan_50

zuul_khan_60_70 Zuul'khan: “I didn't expect petrifying. Who would use such a weak spell that has to be renewed every few weeks?”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_80

zuul_khan_60_80 Zuul'khan: “I could not move but I noticed everything that was happening around me. Lotho Bogsten visited me regularly and renewed the spell.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_100

zuul_khan_60_100 Zuul'khan: “Finally, after long, long years, Lotho Bogsten must have died. Fortunately, his son is not so dutiful.”

  • “He had children?” → zuul_khan_60_120

zuul_khan_60_120 Zuul'khan: “Indeed he had a son. But that lazybones didn't come as regularly as needed. The spell wore off, and I could move again.”

  • Next → zuul_khan_60_140

zuul_khan_60_140 Zuul'khan: “AHAHAHAHA!” — effects: sets stage 70 of Fungi panic

  • Next → zuul_khan_70

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Down in a hole, in the mountain side near Prim, I found signs of a heinous torture. At least three corpses were there. I felt the urge to get out of there as fast as I could and immediately report what I found to someone in the village.

docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 5 I arrived at Brightport's school, only to be told that Stanwick is not allowed visitors. Dibella (brightport_school) – – 10 Janwick, Stanwick's grandfather, mistook me for Andor and asked me to deliver some fresh fruit to Stanwick. Janwick (brightport_stanwick) – gives 1× Fresh fruit for Stanwick 15 I was allowed to visit Stanwick. Dibella (brightport_school) carry 1× Fresh fruit for Stanwick, stage 16 – 16 I learned that Stanwick is under investigation as the main suspect in the disappearance of an important scroll from the school library. Dibella (brightport_school) – sets stage 66 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 20 Stanwick has something important to tell me about Andor, but I must help him first.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Brightport school7. stepping on a trigger on brightport_school7Stanwick (brightport_school7) – sets stage 126 of Search for Andor 25 I agreed to help Stanwick find the culprit responsible for the theft. I should look for clues around the school.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Brightport school7. stepping on a trigger on brightport_school7Stanwick (brightport_school7) stage 20 – 30 Milena, the school cook, told me that last year she noticed a dark figure sneaking off from the living quarters. Milena (brightport_school3) stage 25 – 31 Dibella, the lady at the desk at the entrance, told me that Stanwick has a respectable reputation, but as the library supervisor he must be considered a suspect. Dibella (brightport_school) stage 25, stage 35 – 35 Oswald, the Headmaster, expressed his disbelief that Stanwick is guilty of the theft and accepted my help in finding the document, whilst insisting that it be returned to him. Oswald (brightport_school9) stage 25 – 40 Frederich, the history teacher who moved in from Feygard, believes Stanwick is associated with "Those Nor City savages" and was told by them to steal the document. Frederich (brightport_school10) stage 25 – 45 Franz, the math teacher, told me that the most logical thing to do is to investigate the library, which is sealed. I must find a way to access it. Franz (brightport_school12) – – 46 I asked the Headmaster for access to the library, but he denied my request. Oswald (brightport_school9) stage 35, stage 45 – 47 I stole the library key from the Headmaster's desk while he was distracted. Hopefully there will be no consequences. Oswald (brightport_school9) stage 35, stage 46 gives 1× Library key 50 Counterfeit, a thieves guild member in the basement of the Brightport warehouse, gave me a copy of the library key. Counterfeit (brightport_thieves) pay 2,000 gold, stage 46 gives 1× Library key 55 In the library's basement archive, I found a record of a baker named Bryma requesting to read the secret scroll, but she was denied. Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 2 – 6 Umar gave me some advice. My strength is not always the solution. I must "use my tongue" to avoid raising suspicion in the tavern. Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 4 – 10 Ambelie Laumwill doesn't want to come with me peacefully. I cannot make a scene, or the guards will alert other patrols. Maybe talking with them would solve the situation. Ambelie (foaming_flask) stage 4 – 15 I have "used my tongue" with the main Feygard soldier in the Foaming Flask tavern. He gave me permission to "escort back" Ambelie. Feygard patrol captain (foaming_flask) pay 1,000 gold, stage 10 – 20 I knocked out Ambelie. I will take her back to the Guild. Ambelie (foaming_flask) stage 15 removes monsters from foaming_flaskspawns monsters on road1applies condition carrying_ambeliesets stage 20 of Thieves Hidden (hidden flag) 21 I have decided not to kidnap Ambelie. I must think of another solution. Ambelie (foaming_flask) – – 24 Ambelie gave me a very valuable necklace. I must talk with Umar and persuade him to no longer pursue her. Ambelie (foaming_flask) stage 21 gives 1× Sapphire Necklacespawns monsters on road1sets stage 20 of Thieves Hidden (hidden flag) 30 I safely brought Ambelie to the basement. However, keeping her here could be dangerous. Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 20 1,200 XP 35 Umar believes there is a secure room for these types of "visitors". I should talk to Troublemaker. Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 30 – 40 I have talked to Troublemaker about the place Umar believes it's okay to safely keep the hostage. Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 35 – 45 Troublemaker has given me the key to the Guild brig. I should take Ambelie there and leave her to wake up. Troublemaker (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 40 1,000 XPgives 1× Guild brig key 50 I've inserted the key and moved the lever. A hatchway has opened in the room.🗺️ Part of Fallhaven gravedigger visibly changes. walking into a blocked passage on fallhaven_gravedigger carry 1× Guild brig key, hand over 1× Guild brig key, stage 45 changes map fallhaven_gravedigger 55 I left Ambelie in that ugly, dark, and cold place. I should go back.🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on Guildbrig2. walking into a blocked passage on guildbrig2 stage 50 spawns monsters on guildbrig2applies condition carrying_ambelie 60 Troublemaker gave me some bread for Ambelie. The guild doesn't want her to starve to death. Indeed, they want her to be as comfortable as possible. I must go to the brig again. Troublemaker (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 55 gives 5× Bread 65 I gave the bread to Ambelie. I should report Troublemaker that I completed the job.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Guildbrig2. stepping on a trigger on guildbrig2Ambelie (foaming_flask) hand over 5× Bread, stage 60 400 XP 70 The job finally seems to be finished. I just have to talk with Umar again. However, I do not feel good about this. Kidnappings are definitely not my kind of job. Troublemaker (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 65 – 75 I completed this task successfully. Umar told me they have sent couriers to Feygard, and the ransom is almost guaranteed. He paid me for my work. (completes quest) Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) stage 70 4,500 XPfaction “ThievesGuild” +10gives 2500× Gold coins 76 Umar took the necklace as compensation for my errors. Everything is fine again. (completes quest) Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) hand over 1× Sapphire Necklace, stage 21, stage 24 2,250 XPfaction “ThievesGuild” +10

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 Two Elytharan slave ghosts spoke quietly of another who has not joined them at the table. They said she still hides east of them, afraid the Shades might return. Liberated Elytharan ghost (undertell_3_00) – – 20 The ghosts said the girl believed she could protect herself with a folded copper talisman she made long ago, but she lost it before she could hide it away from the evil of Undertell. Liberated Elytharan ghost (undertell_3_00) stage 10 – 30 They remembered that such objects were sometimes taken during inspections, gathered with other personal effects and carried upward to the Masters. Liberated Elytharan ghost (undertell_3_00) stage 20 – 40 I was told that one of the Masters may still possess the folded copper talisman, kept not for protection, but for understanding. Liberated Elytharan ghost (undertell_3_00) stage 30 spawns monsters on undertell_3_12 50 A Master acknowledged the talisman when I asked about it. He spoke of fear made solid, and said such fear was useful to those who taught the Shadow obedience rather than faith. It can be found in the "lower records", whatever that means.🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on Undertell 4 00. Thalen (undertell_3_lava_00) stage 40 – 60 In the Undertell archival room, I found the folded coin talisman. walking into a blocked passage on undertell_archive2 – gives 1× Folded copper talisman 70 I found the terrified girl hiding behind a collapsed rock wall. She would not approach me, nor leave her hiding place. walking into a blocked passage on undertell_3_12 stage 40 – 80 I tossed the folded copper talisman to her. Only then did she step forward, no longer clinging to the corner she had claimed as safety. walking into a blocked passage on undertell_3_12 stage 70 removes monsters from undertell_3_12spawns monsters on undertell_3_00 90 The girl rejoined the others at the table. The Elytharan ghosts spoke her name softly, as if afraid to lose her again. (completes quest) Liberated Elytharan ghost (undertell_3_00) stage 80 10,207 XP

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 In a lonely house on a peninsula at the northern shore of lake Laeroth up in the mountains to the north-east, I met a woman called Algangror. Algangror (lonelyhouse0) – – 11 She has a rodent problem and needs help dealing with some of them that she has trapped in her basement. Algangror (lonelyhouse0) – – 15 I have agreed to help Algangror deal with her rodent problem. I should return to her when I have killed all six rodents in her basement. Algangror (lonelyhouse0) – – 20 Algangror thanked me for helping her with her problem. Algangror (lonelyhouse0) hand over 6× Strange looking rat tail, stage 15 5,000 XP 21 She also told me not to talk to anyone in Remgard about her whereabouts. Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 I've agreed to help the Feygard patrol captain investigate why there is so much beer on the Foaming flask tavern property. He suggested that I ask other tavern owners for more information. Torilo (foaming_flask) pay 10,000 gold, stage 10 – 30 After bribing Tharwyn, the owner of the Vilegard tavern, he stated as part of his 'business agreement', Dunla, the local thief, is one of his 'distributors'.   1. Talk to Feygard patrol captain (foaming_flask) → choose “Anything for the glorious Feygard.” — conditions: NOT reached stage 10 of Beer Bootlegging → stage 10. NPC: “Great to hear. I need you to talk with the tavern owner and find out anything you can about the beer.”
Stage 20: 1 route
  1. Talk to Torilo (foaming_flask) → choose “What does that mean?” — conditions: latest stage of Beer Bootlegging is 10; pay 10,000 gold → stage 20. NPC: “It means that that is all I will tell you and I suggest you talk to another tavern owner.”
Stage 30: 1 route
  1. Talk to Tharwyn (vilegard_tavern) → choose “The thief?” — conditions: reached stage 30 of Trusting an outsider; reached stage 32 of sullengard_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 30 of Beer Bootlegging → stage 30. NPC: “That is Dunla. He gets me my beer. Go talk to him.”

  1. Talk to Dunla (vilegard_tavern) → choose “Is the Thieves guild the 'distributors'?” — conditions: latest stage of Beer Bootlegging is 30; reached stage 50 of The ruthless Crackshot → stage 40. NPC: “Yes, yes we are, but if you want to learn more, go talk to Farrik back at our guild house.”

docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 Bjorgur in Prim at the base of the Blackwater mountain thinks that something has disturbed the grave of his parents, to the southwest of Prim, just outside the Elm mine. Bjorgur (blackwater_mountain26) stage 15 – 15 Bjorgur wants me to go check the grave, and make sure his family's dagger is still secure in the tomb. Bjorgur (blackwater_mountain26) – – 20 Fulus in Prim is interested in obtaining Bjorgur's family dagger that Bjorgur's grandfather used to possess. Fulus (blackwater_mountain28) – – 30 I met a man that wielded a strange looking dagger in the lower parts of a tomb to the southwest of Prim. He must have robbed this dagger from the grave. Graverobber (blackwater_mountain35) – – 40 I placed the dagger back into its place in the tomb. The restless undead seem much less restless now, strangely enough. reading a sign on blackwater_mountain35 hand over 1× Bjorgur's family dagger 200 XP 50 Bjorgur thanked me for my assistance. He told me I should also seek his relatives in Feygard. (completes quest) Bjorgur (blackwater_mountain26) stage 15, stage 40 1,100 XP 51 I have told Fulus that I helped Bjorgur return his family dagger to its original place. Fulus (blackwater_mountain28) – – 60 I have given Bjorgur's family dagger to Fulus. He thanked me for bringing it to him, and rewarded me handsomely. (completes quest) Fulus (blackwater_mountain28) hand over 1× Bjorgur's family dagger, stage 20 1,700 XPgives Gold coins

docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 Leonid in Crossglen town hall tells me that there was a disturbance in the village some weeks ago. Apparently, Lord Geomyr has banned all use of bonemeal as a healing substance. Tharal, the town priest should know more. Leonid – – 20 Tharal does not want to talk about bonemeal. I might be able to persuade him by bringing him 5 insect wings. Tharal stage 10 – 30 Tharal tells me that bonemeal is a very potent healing substance, and is quite upset that it is not allowed anymore. I should go see Thoronir in Fallhaven if I want to learn more. I should tell him the password 'Glow of the Shadow'. Tharal hand over 5× Insect wing, stage 10 – 40 I have talked to Thoronir in Fallhaven. He might be able to mix me a bonemeal potion if I bring him 5 skeletal bones. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven. Thoronir (fallhaven_church) stage 30 – 50 Thoronir in Fallhaven explained to me that bonemeal potions are banned by Lord Geomyr, so I have refused his request to provide him with fresh ingredients for new bonemeal potions. I could do him a favour though to bring him 5 skeletal bones for church matters. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven. Thoronir (fallhaven_church) stage 30 – 100 I have brought the bones to Thoronir. He is now able to supply me with bonemeal potions. I should be careful when using them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use. (completes quest) Thoronir (fallhaven_church) hand over 5× Bone, stage 30 900 XP 110 I have brought the bones to Thoronir. Of course he wouldn't produce any bonemeal potion from them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use. (completes quest) Thoronir (fallhaven_church) hand over 5× Bone, stage 30, stage 50 900 XP

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 5 Fiamma, the swordsmith of Brightport. Is willing to forge me a sword if I can bring him the materials. Fiamma (brightport_weapon) – – 10 In the mountains near the road to Remgard lies a dangerous area overrun by Arulirs, beasts with skin as tough as steel. Fiamma (brightport_weapon) – – 15 Fiamma has asked for a strip of Arulir skin, coveted for its durability and flexibility. He also requires 15 cold lava rocks from the mountain cave, which burn hotter than any ordinary coal. Fiamma (brightport_weapon) – – 20 The final material is a red crystal from a Gornaud, a ferocious beast that sometimes forms these rare crystals in its body. Fiamma (brightport_weapon) – – 25 I brought Fiamma the arulir skin and lava rocks. Fiamma (brightport_weapon) stage 25, stage 30 starts timer “fiamma_forge” 40 To my surprise, the sword he forged heats up on contact with air and requires special gloves to handle. They are made of the Arulir skin I brought. Fiamma (brightport_weapon) – – 45 I asked Fiamma to give me something else, and he gave me a very sharp glaive. (completes quest) Fiamma (brightport_weapon) – gives 1× Glaive of Imeria 50 I thanked Fiamma and went on my merry way. (completes quest) Fiamma (brightport_weapon) – gives 1× Glaive of Imeriagives 1× Flaming greatswordgives 1× Salamander gloves

docs.text: Inside a house in Brightport, I met two people named Dynes and Barthold. It turned out that they are the friends Benbyr told me to visit. Rather lacking in hospitality, they offered me work.

docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 Inside a house in Brightport, I met two people named Dynes and Barthold. It turned out that they are the friends Benbyr told me to visit. Rather lacking in hospitality, they offered me work. Barthold (brightport_benbyr) – – 20 Barthold was hesitant because any job I could do for them would put me at odds with Gunfryk the guard commander. Taking that into account I offered to rid them of him. Barthold (brightport_benbyr) – – 30 I was told not to kill him, but surely it won't be a problem if I do. Either way I'll resolve things for them. Barthold (brightport_benbyr) stage 20 – 40 I received some records from silvear that could be useful as blackmail against Gunfryk. Silvear (brightport1) pay 1,000 gold, stage 30 – 50 I lied to the commander that there are some lizardmen in the derelict house east of town, I should go there and prepare an ambush. Gunfryk (brightport_bakery) – removes monsters from brightport_bakerysets stage 234 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 60 I used the records to blackmail Gunfryk. To save his reputation he begrudgingly agreed to give Barthold and Dynes some leeway. Gunfryk (brightport_bakery) stage 40 – 70 I ambushed and killed Gunfryk in the house to the east, along with the two guards he brought.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Brightport abandoned. stepping on a trigger on brightport_abandoned – starts timer “brightport_new”clears stage 234 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 80 I informed the commander about Barthold and Dynes' scheme. He requested that I find some incriminating evidence of their role. Gunfryk (brightport_bakery) stage 30 – 90 Barthold was happy with my work and gave me a reward, he said I could find more work like this in Nor City. (completes quest) Barthold (brightport_benbyr) stage 30, stage 60 4,420 XPgives 1200× Gold coinssets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 100 Barthold was a little disappointed about me killing Gunfryk. It's possible that now Feygard might take more severe action with Brightport. (completes quest) Barthold (brightport_benbyr) stage 30, stage 70 6,950 XPgives 1000× Gold coinssets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 110 I found some of the duo's merchandise in the smuggling cave east of brightport. walking into a blocked passage on brightport_smugglercave1 stage 80 sets stage 154 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)gives 1× Nor city made blade 119 I gave the commander the blade, even though I already got paid not to. If there's any honor among Nor City's thieves, they will surely have none to spare for me. no trigger in the game data or code ? – – 120 Gunfryk was happy with my work, the duo will soon be jailed. He said Feygard needs more brave youngsters like me and that I should give the military academy a try. (completes quest) Gunfryk (brightport_bakery) – 3,400 XPsets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)spawns monsters on brightport_benbyrstarts timer “brightport_arrest”sets stage 212 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)gives 700× Gold coins 130 I opted to blackmail the duo instead for some quick gold. Should've had the Guild's protection, suckers! Barthold (brightport_benbyr) carry 1× Nor city made blade, stage 110, stage 30 gives 1869× Gold coins 135 I told the commander I couldn't find anything Gunfryk (brightport_bakery) stage 110, stage 80 – 136 Barthold was disappointed in me for having done nothing about Gunfryk. Little did he know I lined my pockets with his merchandise. (completes quest) Barthold (brightport_benbyr) stage 135, stage 30 sets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 140 I told the commander I couldn't find anything, even though I had the blade I blackmailed Barthold and Dynes with. (completes quest) Gunfryk (brightport_bakery) stage 130, stage 80 sets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 150 Gunfryk (brightport_bakery) – sets stage 139 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)spawns monsters on brightport_benbyrstarts timer “brightport_arrest”sets stage 212 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)

No trigger: as of v0.8.18, nothing in the game's dialogue, maps or code sets this stage. It may be unused or unfinished content, or set in a way this wiki can't trace yet. That doesn't make it a secret: treat anything you hear about it as speculation.

Bryma (brightport_forest) stage 1 – 10 I agreed to help Bryma with her problem. She shared the activation phrase for another statue leading deeper into the forest. Bryma (brightport_forest) stage 1 – 15 After navigating through the caves, I reached an open chamber beyond the rubble, where I found the lizardman again. no trigger in the game data or code ? – – 20 The lizardman regarded me suspiciously, calling me an intruder. He claimed Bryma had been stealing bones from their ancestral tomb, which his people were trying to recover.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Brightport cave10. stepping on a trigger on brightport_cave10Mysterious lizard creature (brightport_cave1) – sets stage 116 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) 25 I attacked the lizardman, but my attack merely grazed it, before it fled deeper into the caves.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Brightport cave10. stepping on a trigger on brightport_cave10Mysterious lizard creature (brightport_cave1) – sets stage 116 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag)removes monsters from brightport_cave10 30 I tried to calm Emyro's worries. docs.title: How each stage is reached
docs.text:
Every dialogue route found in the game data, including alternatives that end up in the same place. "Conditions" are everything checked along that dialogue path.

Stage 5: 1 route
  1. Talk to Othinus (brightport_temple) → the conversation leads here automatically → stage 5. NPC: “I'm in the middle of an important ritual. If you require something, please consult with my steward, Stiyl.”
Stage 10: 1 route
  1. Talk to Stiyl (brightport_temple1) → choose “Can you tell me the story about the temple again?” — conditions: reached stage 10 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) → stage 10. NPC: “In the past, the chapel was only a minor shrine. The people of Brightport used to worship the Shadow at the great…”
Stage 15: 1 route
  1. Talk to Silvear (brightport1) → choose “What is it that you were selling again?” — conditions: reached stage 15 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); NOT reached stage 30 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) → stage 15. NPC: “I specialize in trading information, rumors, stories, and the like. Not something I could sell to a kid like you.”
Stage 20: 2 routes
  1. Talk to Silvear (brightport1) → choose “The only thing wider than my purse is my patience for the likes of you. [pay him the gold]” — conditions: reached stage 15 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); reached stage 30 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); pay 500 gold; NOT reached stage 20 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); pay 2,000 gold → stage 20. NPC: “To find our hideout, go inside via the door on the right. Best of luck to you.”
  2. Talk to Silvear (brightport1) → choose “Must I remind you that the profits from Fallhaven's Guild deals with Sullengard are also reaching the Guild…” — conditions: reached stage 15 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); reached stage 30 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); pay 500 gold; NOT reached stage 20 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); reached stage 50 of The ruthless Crackshot; reached stage 10 of Another ruthless Crackshot → stage 20. NPC: “To find our hideout, head inside via the door on the right. Best of luck to you.”
Stage 25: 1 route
  1. Talk to Silvear (brightport1) → choose “The only thing wider than my purse is my patience for the likes of you. [pay him the gold]” — conditions: reached stage 15 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); reached stage 30 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); pay 500 gold; NOT reached stage 20 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); pay 2,000 gold → stage 25. NPC: “To find our hideout, go inside via the door on the right. Best of luck to you.”
Stage 30: 1 route
  1. Talk to Silvear (brightport1) → choose “Can you tell me about Andor again?” — conditions: reached stage 15 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); reached stage 30 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) → stage 30. NPC: “As I mentioned, I'm a merchant. I can tell you about Andor, but it will cost you. Say, 500 gold?”
Stage 31: 1 route
  1. Talk to Silvear (brightport1) → choose “For my brother it is worth that much.” — conditions: reached stage 15 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); reached stage 30 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); pay 500 gold → stage 31. NPC: “Thanks for the business kid.”
Stage 33: 2 routes
  1. Talk to Freya (brightport_armorer) → the conversation leads here automatically → stage 33. NPC: “Welcome to Brightport's armor smithy, how can I assist you?”
  2. Talk to Freya (brightport_armorer) → choose “Please show me your wares.” → stage 33
Stage 35: 1 route
  1. Talk to Hortensia (brightport_bakery) → choose “He has been missing for a while, and so my father sent me out to search for him. Have you seen him?” — conditions: NOT reached stage 900 of Excluded endings for the main quest andor (hidden flag) → stage 35. NPC: “I'm afraid I cannot be of much help. I haven't seen Andor since his days at the Brightport academy. I hope you find…”
Stage 40: 1 route
  1. stepping on a trigger on brightport_smugglercave → choose “Some easy gold, who doesn't love that. [Take the gold.]” — conditions: NOT reached stage 40 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag) → stage 40; also gives 500× Gold coins. NPC: “You take the 500 gold.”
Stage 42: 1 route
  1. Talk to Franz (brightport_school12) → choose “Could you tell me what you know about the library theft?” — conditions: NOT reached stage 45 of brightport_nondisplay (hidden flag); reached stage 25 of No rest for the wicked → stage 42. NPC: “As I've said, I'm busy. Write your question down and I'll answer you later.”
Stage 45: 1 route
  1. Talk to Franz (brightport_school12) → choose “[Give written note]” — conditions: hand over 1× Written note → stage 45; also starts timer “franz_note_read_timer”. NPC: “I'll read it next after I'm done with this other paper. Please come back later.”
Stage 50: 1 route

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: I asked Edrin about the strange-looking dagger I purchased. He told me he recognizes it because he made it many years ago, and it used to have a gem mounted in the pommel. If I can find the gem he can remount it in the dagger, and the dagger will have special properties. Apparently it used to belong to someone named Lawellyn.

Hidden story flag

An internal quest the game uses to track your progress behind the scenes. It never shows up in your journal. The entries below are the developers' notes to themselves, so expect them to be terse.

Quest ID brv_nondisplay In journal No (hidden flag) Stages 36 Started by stepping on a trigger on brimhaven_inn_east NPCs involved Alkapoan, Churrie, Feygard soldier, Feygard soldier, Feygard soldier, Gnossath +5 Locations brimhaven1, brimhaven4, brimhaven_fortune_teller, brimhaven_house1 Total XP 500 Related quests 7

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 1 I met a man seeking help for his settlement, the 'Blackwater mountain'. Supposedly, his settlement is being attacked by monsters and bandits, and they need help from the outside. Agent (blackwater_mountain5) – – 5 I have agreed to help the man and Blackwater mountain in dealing with the problem. Agent (blackwater_mountain5) – – 10 The man told me to meet him on the other side of the collapsed mine. He will crawl through the mine shaft and I will descend into the pitch-black abandoned mine.🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on Blackwater mountain5. Agent (blackwater_mountain5) – removes monsters from blackwater_mountain5 20 I have navigated through the pitch-black abandoned mine, and met the man on the other side. He seemed very anxious about telling me to head straight to the east once I exit the mine. I should meet the man at the bottom of the mountain to the east. Agent (blackwater_mountain9) – – 25 I heard a story about Prim and the Blackwater mountain settlement fighting against each other. Guthbered (blackwater_mountain29) – – 30 I should follow the mountain path up the mountain to the Blackwater mountain settlement. Agent (blackwater_mountain14) – – 40 I met the man again on my way up to Blackwater mountain. I should proceed further up the mountain. Agent (blackwater_mountain17) – – 50 I have made it up to the snow-filled parts of the Blackwater mountain. The man told me to proceed further up the mountain. Apparently, the Blackwater mountain settlement is close by. Agent (blackwater_mountain30) – – 60 I have reached the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should find and talk to their battle master, Harlenn.🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on Blackwater mountain38. Agent (blackwater_mountain38) – – 65 I have spoken to Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Apparently, the settlement is under attack by a number of monsters, the aulaeth and white wyrms. On top of that, they are being attacked by the people of Prim. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) – – 66 Harlenn thinks the people of Prim are behind the monster attacks somehow. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) stage 65 – 70 Harlenn wants me to give a message to Guthbered of Prim. Either the people of Prim stop their attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement, or they will have to be dealt with themselves. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) – – 80 Guthbered denies that the people of Prim have anything to do with the monster attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn. Guthbered (blackwater_mountain29) stage 70 – 90 Harlenn is sure that the people of Prim are behind the attacks somehow. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) stage 70, stage 80 – 95 Harlenn wants me to go to Prim and look for signs that they are preparing for an attack on the settlement. I should go look for clues around where Guthbered stays. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) – – 100 I have found some plans in Prim about recruiting mercenaries and attacking the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn immediately. reading a sign on blackwater_mountain29 stage 95 – 110 Harlenn thanked me for investigating the attack plans. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) stage 100, stage 95 1,150 XP 120 To make the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement stop, Harlenn wants me to assassinate Guthbered in Prim. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) – – 130 I have started a fight with Guthbered. Guthbered (blackwater_mountain29) – faction “fct_prim” set to -10 131 I told Guthbered that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left Prim. Guthbered (blackwater_mountain29) – 2,100 XP 149 I have told Harlenn that Guthbered is gone. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) hand over 1× Guthbered's ring, stage 120 – 150 Harlenn thanked me for the help I have provided. Hopefully, the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement should stop now. Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) stage 149 5,000 XPgives Sword of Shadow's rage, Gold coins, Regular potion of health 240 I am now trusted in the Blackwater mountain settlement, and all services should be available for me to use. (completes quest) Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) stage 150 – 250 I have decided to not help the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement. (completes quest) Guthbered (blackwater_mountain29)Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) stage 70 – 251 Since I am helping Prim, Harlenn no longer wants to talk to me. (completes quest) Harlenn (blackwater_mountain45) – –

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 I heard a rumor that some mining town in the Charwood forest, northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern, has had some troubles recently. I should try to find the Charwood cabin and find out what has happened. Lethenlor (tradehouse1) – – 11 I heard someone mention that the mining town of Charwood heights has had some troubles recently. I should search for the Charwood cabin in the forest northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern. Erethori (waytominingtown1a) – – 19 I have found the Charwood cabin in the forest northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern. Guard (waytominingtown2)Drashad (tradehouse0)Khorailla (tradehouse0)+2 more – – 20 Maevalia in the Charwood cabin told me a story about how their mining settlement was attacked by some monsters, forcing them to flee down the mountain. They are still missing several of their friends and relatives from the Charwood heights, either killed or captured by the monsters. Maevalia (tradehouse0) stage 30 – 21 In particular, Maevalia mentions four people that are greatly missed; their former leader Morenavia, their weapons trainer Falothen, the healer Ayell and their armorer Fayvara. Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 I met Miri in the Crossroads Guardhouse. Miri (galmore_41) – – 20 Since I had helped Ailshara, she wouldn't tell me about Andor. (completes quest) Miri (galmore_41) – 1 XPremoves monsters from loneford4 40 Since I had aided Feygard once or twice earlier, she would tell me about Andor, after I had completed an investigation for her. Miri (galmore_41) – – 50 Since Miri was poisoned by slitherers near Sullengard, and healing is taking time, she wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the strange areas to the south of Stoutford. Miri (galmore_41) – sets stage 3 of Darkness in the Daylight and Shadows - Non displayed (hidden flag)spawns monsters on galmore_45 60 I went to the area to the south of Stoutford and encountered an impassable force there. walking into a blocked passage on galmore_45 stage 50 – 70 There was a piece of Kazaul ritual there, which I had encountered before. I should inform Miri. walking into a blocked passage on galmore_45 stage 50, stage 60 – 80 Miri asked me where I had seen this before. I told her about a task I had carried out on behalf of Throdna of the Blackwater settlement. Miri (galmore_41) stage 60, stage 70 – 90 Miri told me to meet him and enquire further. And gave me a phrase to use whenever he started rambling. Miri (galmore_41) – – 100 Throdna told me it was part of a ritual to break the barrier which forms when one does a ritual to call strong Kazaul monsters. Throdna (blackwater_mountain50) stage 90 – 110 The ritual consisted of two parts which I had found earlier, and a chant in a book called Calomyran Secrets. I need to report this to Miri. Throdna (blackwater_mountain50) stage 90 – 120 I told Miri about finding the book for an Old Man in Fallhaven. She told me to talk to him. Miri (galmore_41) stage 100, stage 110 – 130 The Old Man would not let me borrow the book, so I started noting the chant in front of him. Old man (fallhaven_nw) stage 110 – 140 The book contained half the chant. The rest was to be found in another book Azimyran Secrets. Old man (fallhaven_nw) stage 110 – 150 Miri told me she'd trace the book. She told me to wait for her return. Miri (galmore_41) stage 120, stage 140 removes monsters from houseatcrossroads0starts timer “dds_miri” 160 Miri came back and told me that the book Azimyran Secrets was with an old hermit near Arulir mountain. Miri (galmore_41) stage 150 – 170 I met the old hermit and asked him about the book, Azimyran Secrets. Old hermit (waytolake12) stage 160 – 180 He refused to give it to me, so I copied the chant sitting with him. I needed to tell Miri. Old hermit (waytolake12) stage 160 – 190 Miri told me to hurry, and pass the barrier. Miri (galmore_41) – removes monsters from houseatcrossroads0 198 After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman. Mourning woman (galmore_45) stage 190 5,000 XP 200 She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life. Mourning woman (galmore_45) stage 190 spawns monsters on galmore_45 210 Miri, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayavar with Kazaul's monsters. Miri (galmore_41)Mourning woman (galmore_45) stage 190 – 220 The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest who walks on lava east of the Purple Hills. Miri (galmore_41)Mourning woman (galmore_45) stage 190, stage 210 removes monsters from galmore_45spawns monsters on loneford4 230 We let the mourning woman go. no trigger in the game data or code ? – – 232 The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again. Mourning woman (galmore_45) stage 220 2,000 XP 240 I had to travel to the lava wastelands. Miri (galmore_41)Mourning woman (galmore_45) stage 190, stage 220 spawns monsters on galmore_41 250 There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red. Dark priest (galmore_41) stage 190 – 260 He accused me of interfering. Miri, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster. Dark priest (galmore_41)Miri (galmore_41) stage 190 removes monsters from galmore_41spawns monsters on galmore_41 270 I defeated the monster. Miri (galmore_41) stage 260 – 280 Miri fulfilled her promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his food supplies at Rosmara's food stand. Miri (galmore_41) stage 260 15,000 XPremoves monsters from galmore_41spawns monsters on houseatcrossroads0sets stage 6 of Darkness in the Daylight and Shadows - Non displayed (hidden flag)spawns monsters on wayto_feygard_duleian_2 300 Indeed, I have found Andor there. docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 I met Gandoren, the guard captain at the Crossroads guardhouse. He told me about some trouble up in Loneford, that have forced the guards to be even more alert than usual. Because of this, they can't do their regular errands themselves but need help with some basic things. Gandoren – – 20 Gandoren wants me to help him transport a shipment of 10 iron swords to another guard post to the south. Gandoren – – 21 I have agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment, as a service for Feygard. Gandoren stage 20 – 22 I have grudgingly agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment. Gandoren stage 20 – 25 I should deliver the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern. Gandoren stage 22 gives Feygard iron sword 26 Gandoren tells me that Ailshara has expressed some interest in the Feygard shipments, and urges me to stay away from her. docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 In Undertell, the Kazaul Masters spoke to me. They claimed a forgotten ritual could seal the Rift once and for all. Zaroth (undertell_4_00)Morvath (undertell_00)Thalen (undertell_3_lava_00)+1 more – – 20 They told me that this ritual was stolen long ago by a Lethgar named Varnel, who fled Undertell with it. I agreed to recover it, believing it might save Dhayavar. Zaroth (undertell_4_00)Morvath (undertell_00)Thalen (undertell_3_lava_00)+1 more stage 10 – 30 In the upper dormitory tunnels of Undertell, I met the ghost of a miner who remembered Varnel. The ghost said Varnel escaped through the northern caverns and headed east toward the Sutdover River. Could he have meant Sullengard? Durnan the Hollow (undertell_1_0) stage 20 – 40 I traveled to Sullengard and spoke with Kealwea, the local priest. He recalled a relic matching my description once being sent to the Shadow church library in Remgard. Kealwea (sullengard_church) stage 30 – 50 In Remgard's church basement, I spoke with Gwendolyn, the librarian. She said she knew nothing of any ritual but allowed me to search the shelves myself. Gwendolyn (remgard_church_basement) stage 40 – 55 I discovered a small, locked box hidden behind the books. Its surface was etched with strange curling runes and old scorch marks. The box refused to open. walking into a blocked passage on remgard_church_basement stage 50 gives 1× Ancient locked box 58 After I asked Gwendolyn about the locked box that I found, she directed me to speak with Skylenar upstairs. Gwendolyn (remgard_church_basement) carry 1× Ancient locked box, stage 55 – 60 Skylenar told me the box was an ancient relic, sealed by dragonkind and said to open only to a dragon's claw. Skylenar (remgard_church) carry 1× Ancient locked box, stage 58 – 65 Skylenar mentioned that some old Shadow tales spoke of ash-covered scales found deep within Undertell, hinting that one such beast may once have lived there. Skylenar (remgard_church) carry 1× Ancient locked box, stage 58 – 70 In the glowing white house basement, I talked to Falkour the dragon. When I showed him the locked box, he recognized it as a relic once held by Varnel.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on White house basement. walking into a blocked passage on white_house_basementstepping on a trigger on white_house_basement carry 1× Ancient locked box, stage 65 – 72 Falkour gifted me one of his claws, saying it could break the seal, and warned me to use it only for that purpose. Time to find a safe place in this basement to open the box.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on White house basement. walking into a blocked passage on white_house_basementstepping on a trigger on white_house_basement carry 1× Ancient locked box, stage 65 gives 1× Dragon claw 75 Using Falkour's claw, I unlocked the ancient box. Inside were the five pages of the Kazaul ritual the Masters desired.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on White house basement. stepping on a trigger on white_house_basement carry 1× Ancient locked box, carry 1× Dragon claw, hand over 1× Ancient locked box, stage 72 gives 1× The Ritual of Five Aspects 78 The Master that I brought "The Five Aspects" ritual to sent me to talk to Thalen, the Master of Knowledge. Zaroth (undertell_4_00)Morvath (undertell_00)Vaelzahr (undertell_7_00) carry 1× The Ritual of Five Aspects sets stage 7 of hidden_undertell (hidden flag) 80 I returned the ritual to Thalen. He told me to meet the "lesser kin" at Anavrin's shrine to perform the ceremony. Thalen (undertell_3_lava_00) carry 1× The Ritual of Five Aspects, hand over 1× The Ritual of Five Aspects spawns monsters on undertell_5sets stage 7 of hidden_undertell (hidden flag) 85 As the ritual completed, the Masters revealed their true intent. The rite was not to seal the Rift but to awaken the Fifth Master, whose power might reopen it. They told me the Shadow itself serves Kazaul. Their words left me doubtful, unsure whether I had been deceived or warned.🗺️ Part of Undertell 5 visibly changes. Anavrin (undertell_5)Kazaul acolyte (undertell_5) stage 80 – 90 I left Undertell uncertain of what to believe. If what the Masters said is true, the Shadow may not be what it seems. Still, doubt lingers like smoke after the forge cools. (completes quest) Anavrin (undertell_5) – 14,165 XP

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 5 Yolgen asked me to have a look at what is wrong with Flagstone prison. Yolgen (stoutford_church) – – 10 I met a guard from Stoutford on sentry duty outside a fortress called Flagstone. He told me that Flagstone used to serve as a prison for house Gorland of Stoutford, but it is now abandoned. Recently, undead have started pouring out of Flagstone. I should investigate the source of the undead monsters. The guard tells me to return to him if I need help. Flagstone sentry (flagstone0) – – 20 I found a dug out tunnel beneath Flagstone, that seems to lead to a larger cave. The cave is guarded by a demon that I am not even able to approach. Maybe the guard outside Flagstone knows more? reading a sign on flagstone2 – – 30 The guard suggested that the former warden may have something to do with this, and I should go and look for him. If I find him I should return to the guard with any important news. Flagstone sentry (flagstone0) stage 10, stage 20 – 31 I found the former warden of Flagstone on the upper level. Among his remains I found a necklace with some inscriptions. I should return to the guard now. Undead warden (flagstone_upper) – – 40 I have learned the words required to approach the demon beneath Flagstone. 'Daylight Shadow'. It seems like the warden has something to do with the monster invasion.🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on Flagstone2. Flagstone sentry (flagstone0) hand over 1× Flagstone Warden's necklace, stage 30 1,600 XP 50 Deep beneath Flagstone, I found a powerful winged demon. It seems like the warden kept on running the prison and experimented with necromancy. Winged demon (flagstone4) – – 60 I found one prisoner, Narael, alive deep beneath Flagstone. Narael was once a citizen of Nor City. He is too weak to walk by himself, but if I can find his wife in Nor City, I would be handsomely rewarded. Narael (flagstone4) – – 70 I approached the sentry again and he was happy to hear the source of the undead is gone. I should talk to Yolgen, the priest of Stoutford, for a reward. Every dialogue route found in the game data, including alternatives that end up in the same place. "Conditions" are everything checked along that dialogue path.

  1. Talk to Rhodita (guynmart_wood_1) → choose “Guynmart Castle? I have never heard of it. Please tell me more.” → stage 10. NPC: “I have too much work to do now. But maybe you could check if everything is OK with her?”
Stage 16: 1 route
  1. Talk to Guynmart guard (guynmart) → choose “OK, one kid, without guide, please.” — conditions: pay 12 gold → stage 16; also removes monsters from guynmart
Stage 18: 1 route
  1. Talk to Guynmart guard (guynmart) → choose “One kid and a guide, please.” — conditions: pay 15 gold → stage 18; also removes monsters from guynmart

  1. Talk to Guynmart guard (guynmart) → choose “Here is 100 gold.” — conditions: reached stage 30 of Roses; pay 100 gold → stage 30; also sets stage 1 of gardenGuard blocks (hidden flag)
Stage 32: 1 route
  1. Talk to Guynmart guard (guynmart) → choose “Here is 100 gold.” — conditions: reached stage 30 of Roses; pay 100 gold; NOT reached stage 10 of Roses; NOT reached stage 32 of Roses → stage 32. NPC: “[Gold taken] Very good. Before you enter maybe you should also know the family names: Lord Guynmart, his beautiful but…”
Stage 40: 1 route
  1. Talk to Unkorh (guynmart_main_1) → choose “I would like to buy something to eat.” → stage 40. NPC: “The cook shall give you some bread. And he can provide you with further provisions, if you can pay for them.”
Stage 45: 1 route
  1. Talk to Rob (guynmart_main_3) → the conversation leads here automatically → stage 45; also sets stage 1 of shutters open (hidden flag). NPC: “Hey - you found me at last! That was fun! I am Robalyrius, Guynmart's son, but please call me Rob. Who are you? Wait,…”
Stage 50: 1 route
  1. Talk to Maid (guynmart_main_3) → choose “Perhaps I could go and find Lovis for her.” — conditions: reached stage 50 of Roses → stage 50. NPC: “Ah yes - tell the cook that I asked you to take lunch to Lady Hannah. He hates climbing stairs, so he will gladly agree.”
Stage 60: 1 route
  1. stepping on a trigger on guynmart_main_2 → the conversation leads here automatically — conditions: reached stage 50 of Roses; NOT reached stage 60 of Roses → stage 60. NPC: “[Whispering from below] Oh, how I long to take my place here...”
Stage 62: 1 route
  1. Talk to Hofala (guynmart_main_2) → choose “Hannah's maid asked me to take her lunch to her.” — conditions: reached stage 50 of Roses; NOT reached stage 62 of Roses → stage 62. NPC: “Quick, run to Nuik, the old gardener. He will give you some fresh herbs.”
Stage 64: 1 route
  1. Talk to Hofala (guynmart_main_2) → the conversation leads here automatically — conditions: hand over 1× Hannah's special herbs → stage 64; also gives Hannah's lunch, sets stage 1 of guynmart_quest_cook_lunch (hidden flag). NPC: “...and now it is suitable for her. Hurry now, while it is still hot!”
Stage 70: 1 route
  1. Talk to Hannah (guynmart) → the conversation leads here automatically → stage 70; also spawns monsters on guynmart, clears stage 1 of Guest tour (hidden flag), sets stage 7 of Guest tour (hidden flag). NPC: “I cannot think clearly ... I need a rose! A fresh, fragrant rose! Please bring me a rose from my garden...”
Stage 80: 1 route
  1. Talk to Unkorh (guynmart) → choose “But...” → stage 80; also removes monsters from guynmart. NPC: “Show our - guest - the special exit.”
Stage 81: 1 route
  1. Talk to Norgothla (guynmart_wood_4) → choose “Maybe I could go back and bring some evidence?” → stage 81. NPC: “By doing this, you take a great burden from my heart. I get to know what is happening at the castle, but don't have to…”

  1. Talk to Hannah (guynmart) → the conversation leads here automatically — conditions: carry 1× Rose; hand over 1× Rose → stage 90. NPC: “[Hannah takes the rose] Now. I feel better again. Thank you.”

  1. Talk to Hannah (guynmart) → choose “I will not disappoint you.” — conditions: carry 1× Rose; hand over 1× Rose → stage 100; also gives 1× Lovis' Flute, sets stage 1 of shutters open (hidden flag), removes monsters from guynmart_main_3, spawns monsters on guynmart_tower_3. NPC: “So take this flute and take good care of it.”
Stage 110: 1 route
  1. Talk to Rob (guynmart_tower_3) → choose “Great idea.” → stage 110; also spawns monsters on guynmart_tower_2, removes monsters from guynmart_tower_3. NPC: “Follow me in a minute - but make no noise.”

  1. Talk to Lovis (guynmart_tower_0) → choose “Here, I should give you this.” — conditions: hand over 1× Lovis' Flute → stage 132; also sets stage 6 of guynmart nondisplay (hidden flag), starts timer “guynmart_flute”. NPC: “My flute! How I have missed it! I believe you now.”
Stage 134: 1 route
  1. Talk to Lovis (guynmart_tower_0) → the conversation leads here automatically — conditions: reached stage 132 of Roses; reached stage 134 of Roses → stage 134; also spawns monsters on guynmart_tower_0, removes monsters from guynmart_tower_0. NPC: “Oh no! Look! The torturer! I will run around him and look for Guynmart's personal guards outside in the wood. They…”

  1. walking into a blocked passage on guynmart_tower_0 → the conversation leads here automatically — conditions: killed 1× Torturer → stage 136. NPC: “The door is wide open now.”

  1. Talk to Guynmart (guynmart_main_0) → choose “Ha! So come on and try! No? I will put an end to you now!” → stage 162; also removes monsters from guynmart_main_0. NPC: “OK. I will go now. But I will not forget you - fear my revenge! And before I leave, I will stab your beloved Guynmart...”
  2. Talk to Unkorh (guynmart_main_0) → choose “Ha! So come on and try! No? I will put an end to you now!” → stage 162; also removes monsters from guynmart_main_0. NPC: “OK. I will go now. But I will not forget you - fear my revenge! And before I leave, I will stab your beloved Guynmart...”

  1. stepping on a trigger on guynmart_farmhouse → the conversation leads here automatically — conditions: reached stage 164 of Roses → stage 170; also removes monsters from guynmart, removes monsters from guynmart, removes monsters from guynmart_main_0, removes monsters from guynmart_main_1, removes monsters from guynmart_main_2, removes monsters from guynmart_tower_2, removes monsters from guynmart_wood_4, removes monsters from guynmart_wood_4, removes monsters from guynmart_wood_4, removes monsters from guynmart_wood_4, spawns monsters on guynmart, spawns monsters on guynmart_main_1, spawns monsters on guynmart_main_1, spawns monsters on guynmart_main_1, spawns monsters on guynmart_main_1, clears stage 34 of guynmart nondisplay (hidden flag)

docs.text: Before I leave Laeroth, perhaps I should try to find out where the last Lord went. Maybe there are clues somewhere in the manor.

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 Before I leave Laeroth, perhaps I should try to find out where the last Lord went. Maybe there are clues somewhere in the manor.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothbasement1.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothisland1.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor0.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor3. stepping on a trigger on laerothbasement1 – – 15 I didn't really care about where the last lord went. I left this place, and whatever happened to him didn't make any difference to me. (completes quest)👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothbasement1.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothisland1.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor0.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor3. stepping on a trigger on laerothbasement1 – 1 XP 20 I searched the caretakers room, and found a letter from "Adakin". It says he is leaving to explore his future, but little more than that except that it mentions a chest that contains a diary and other things he could not take with him. I should look for this chest.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor1. stepping on a trigger on laerothmanor1 stage 10 – 30 I have found a chest, with an inscription "Adakin" on the top. It is locked though, so I need to find the key. Hopefully he did not take it with him.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothbasement0. stepping on a trigger on laerothbasement0 stage 20 – 40 I have found a key that looks like it should fit Adakin's chest.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor0. stepping on a trigger on laerothmanor0 stage 30 gives 1× Key for Adakin's chest 50 I have opened Adakin's chest. There are some useful items in here, as well as his diary. The diary has a lock though, so it seems I must find a small key that fits this lock.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothbasement0. stepping on a trigger on laerothbasement0 hand over 1× Key for Adakin's chest, stage 40 gives 1× Adakin's diary 60 I have found a jeweled key that looks like it might be for the diary. Time to try it.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor1. stepping on a trigger on laerothmanor1 stage 50 gives 1× Key for Adakin's diary 70 The key unlocked the diary. The final entry did not really give an answer, except that he intended to go to either Nor City or Feygard, but had yet to decide which. Perhaps I will meet him some day. (completes quest)👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Laerothmanor1. stepping on a trigger on laerothmanor1 hand over 1× Adakin's diary, hand over 1× Key for Adakin's diary, stage 60 1,000 XP

docs.title: Stages
docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 I should find a potion maker called Lodar. Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me that I will need to know the right words to pass a guardian in order to reach Lodar's hideaway. Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) – – 15 Umar told me I should go see someone called Ogam in Vilegard. Ogam can supply me with the right words to reach Lodar's hideaway. Umar (fallhaven_derelict2) – – 20 I have visited Ogam in southwest Vilegard. He was talking in what seemed like riddles. I could barely make out some details when I asked about Lodar's hideaway. 'Halfway between the Shadow and the light. Rocky formations.' and the words 'Glow of the Shadow.' were among the things he said. I am not sure what they mean. Ogam (vilegard_ogam) stage 15 – 30 I have found a formation of rocks on the Duleian Road. It does not look like they were naturally placed, but rather that they are meant to symbolize something. reading a sign on roadbeforecrossroads1 – – 31 Could this be the 'rocky formation' that the old man Ogam mentioned? If that is the case, then this might be a clue as to where Andor went. reading a sign on roadbeforecrossroads1 stage 20 1,500 XP 40 In the woods close to the rocky formation, I encountered a creature blocking the way into the forest. Forest guardian (lodar0) – – 45 By speaking the words that Ogam had mentioned, the creature moved out of the way, and almost seemed to welcome me further into the forest. Forest guardian (lodar0) – 3,000 XP 50 I encountered a guard from Feygard in the woods. He told me a tale of a madman that the guards from Feygard are searching for. The madman is wanted for a number of reasons that he would not disclose. He warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them. Feygard guard (lodar2) – – 51 Before leaving, the guard warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them. Feygard guard (lodar2) – – 60 I found another rocky formation that looked out of place. reading a sign on lodar4 – 2,000 XP 71 I encountered another guard from Feygard, disoriented and lost. The things he said did not make sense. Rambling Feygard guard (lodar2) – – 72 I encountered another guard from Feygard, that seemed to be affected by something. He attacked me without provocation. Afflicted Feygard guard (lodar11) – – 73 I encountered another guard from Feygard, that rambled of something that 'lurks underneath'. He attacked me without provocation. Insane Feygard guard (lodar8) – – 80 I found yet another rocky formation that looked out of place. reading a sign on lodar14 – 2,000 XP 90 In a well-hidden cave, I encountered yet another rocky formation that looked similar to the other ones that I've already seen. I must be getting close to whatever these formations lead to. reading a sign on lodarcave0 – 2,000 XP 100 In the cave, I reached what looks like a tomb. I was unable to venture further into the tomb because of something that held me back. walking into a blocked passage on lodarcave4a – – 110 After navigating through the immense twisty green maze and the damp cave, I have reached a cabin in a clearing. The cabin is occupied by the potion-maker called Lodar. (completes quest) Lodar (lodarhouse1) – 5,000 XP

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: In the maze of green vines east of the Duleian road, I met a guard named Aulowenn from Feygard, guarding some crates. She told me that she was part of a larger group of guards searching for a madman that supposedly hides somewhere in the nearby hills, but that the other guards are now dead or missing.

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 In the maze of green vines east of the Duleian road, I met a guard named Aulowenn from Feygard, guarding some crates. She told me that she was part of a larger group of guards searching for a madman that supposedly hides somewhere in the nearby hills, but that the other guards are now dead or missing. Aulowenn (lodar13) – – 11 Aulowenn requested my help in defeating a monster that haunts the grave of her fellow guards to the east. She warned me that the foul beast will most likely try to trick me into listening to its story. Aulowenn (lodar13) – – 20 I have met the creature that Aulowenn spoke of. Tiqui (lodar14) stage 11 – 22 I listened to the creature's story. Its name is Tiqui, and he is the head of his clan. Apparently, the guards have been ruthlessly killing off his kin. He asked me to kill the guard for him, as revenge for what they have done. Tiqui (lodar14) – – 24 The creature tried to trick me into listening to its story. Tiqui (lodar14) stage 30 – 30 I attacked the creature before it could spew out more of its foul lies. Tiqui (lodar14) – – 31 I attacked Aulowenn. Aulowenn (lodar13) – – 40 Aulowenn thanked me for bringing peace to the grave of her fallen companions by killing the creature. Aulowenn (lodar13) – – 41 Tiqui was overjoyed that I helped him kill the guard for him. He promised that if we ever run into each other again, he'd help me somehow. Tiqui (lodar14) – – 60 I am now able to use Aulowenn's bed whenever I wish to rest. (completes quest)🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on Lodar13. Aulowenn (lodar13)Tiqui (lodar14) – 3,000 XP 65 I will not be able to resolve the conflict between Aulowenn and her attacker. (completes quest) Aulowenn (lodar13)Tiqui (lodar14) stage 30, stage 31 –

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 The potion-maker Lodar seems to be obsessed with something called the Hira'zinn. Lodar (lodarhouse1) – – 15 Apparently, it relates to something that has started to happen recently. Lodar (lodarhouse1) – – 20 Lodar gave me a glowing stone, that he said would allow me to enter some sort of tomb. docs.text:
Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 I heard a story about Loneford. Apparently, a lot of people have become ill there recently, and some have even died. The cause is still unknown. GandorenMinarra (houseatcrossroads4)Farmer (loneford1)+5 more – – 11 I should investigate what could have caused the people of Loneford to become ill. To gather clues, I should ask the citizens of Loneford and the surrounding areas about what they think is the cause. GandorenMinarra (houseatcrossroads4)Farmer (loneford1)+5 more – – 21 The guards in the Crossroads guardhouse are certain that the illness in Loneford is caused by some sabotage done by the priests or people from Nor City. GandorenMinarra (houseatcrossroads4) – – 22 Some villagers in Loneford believe that the illness is caused by the guards from Feygard, in some scheme to make the people suffer even more than they already have. Rolwynn (fields0) stage 11 – 23 Talion, the chapel priest in Loneford, thinks that the illness is the work of the Shadow, as punishment for Loneford's lack of devotion to the Shadow. Talion stage 11 – 24 Taevinn in Loneford is certain that Sienn in the southeast barn has something to do with the illness. Apparently, Sienn keeps a pet around that has approached Taevinn in a threatening manner several times. Taevinn (loneford7) stage 11 – 25 I should go see Landa in the Loneford tavern. Rumor has it that he saw something that he doesn't dare tell anyone. Rolwynn (fields0)Taevinn (loneford7)Talion stage 11, stage 21, stage 22, stage 23, stage 24 – 30 Landa confused me with someone else at first. He apparently saw a boy doing something around the town well during the night before the illness started. He was scared to talk to me at first since he thought I looked like the boy he had seen. Could it have been Andor that he saw? Landa (loneford6) stage 25 – 31 Also, the night after he saw the boy at the well, he saw Buceth taking samples of the water in the well. Strangely enough, Buceth has not gotten ill like the others in the village. Landa (loneford6) stage 25 – 35 I should go question Buceth at the Loneford chapel about what he was doing at the well, and about whether he knows anything about Andor. Landa (loneford6) stage 25 – 41 I have bribed Buceth into talking to me. Buceth pay 1,000 gold, stage 35 – 42 I have told Buceth that I am ready to follow the Shadow. Buceth stage 35 – 45 Buceth tells me that he is assigned by the priests in Nor City to make sure the Shadow casts its glow over Loneford. Apparently, the priests had sent a boy to do some business in Loneford, and Buceth was tasked with gathering some samples from the water well. Buceth – – 50 I have attacked Buceth. I should bring any evidence that Buceth has on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in the longhouse in Loneford. Buceth – – 54 I have given the vial that Buceth had on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in Loneford. Kuldan (loneford3) – – 55 Kuldan thanked me for solving the mystery of the illness in Loneford. They will start bringing in water with help from Feygard instead of drinking from the well from now on. Kuldan also told me to visit the castle steward in Feygard if I want to help further. (completes quest) Kuldan (loneford3) stage 54 15,000 XP 60 I have promised to keep Buceth's story a secret. If Andor was indeed here, he must have had a good reason for doing what he did. Buceth also told me to visit the chapel custodian in Nor City if I want to learn more about the Shadow. (completes quest) Buceth stage 45 15,000 XP

Vaelric (galmore_17_house) stage 95 gives 10× Vaelric's empty bottle 100 I brought the ring back to Eryndor just to tell him that I've decided to keep it. no trigger in the game data or code ? – – 110 When I refused to return the ring, Eryndor attacked me. Eryndor (mt_galmore0_h1) carry 1× Cursed ring of focus, stage 70 – 111 I defeated Eryndor and prevented the hauntings of Vaelric...for now, but I feel that they will resume someday.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Mt galmore nw tower f2.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Mt galmore sw tower f2.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Mt galmore0 h1 2.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on Mt galmore0 h1. stepping on a trigger on mt_galmore0_h1 – clears stage 15 of galmore_nondisplayed (hidden flag) 115 Vaelric is now able to mix up some Insectbane tonic for me. (completes quest) Vaelric (galmore_17_house) carry 10× Pondslime extract, carry 1× Mudfiend goo, carry 5× Duskbloom, carry 5× Mosquito proboscis, have 4,800 gold, stage 97 6,000 XP 120 I've informed Vaelric that I defeated Eryndor but was not able to promise an end to the hauntings, Vaelric was dissatisfied with me and the outcome even going as far as saying that Andor is a better person than I am. (completes quest) Vaelric (galmore_17_house) stage 111 100 XP 123 Eryndor has asked me to find Celdar, a woman from Sullengard and give her the mysterious music box because he has no need for it and it's the right thing to do. Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 Unnmir told me he used to be an adventurer, and gave me a hint to go see Nocmar. His house is just southwest of the tavern in Fallhaven. Unnmir – – 20 Nocmar tells me he used to be a smith. But Lord Geomyr has banned the use of heartsteel, so he cannot forge his weapons anymore. If I can find a heartstone and bring it to Nocmar, he should be able to forge the heartsteel again. Nocmar stage 10 – 30 Nocmar, the Fallhaven smith, said that I could find a heartstone in a place called Undertell which is somewhere near Galmore Mountain. Nocmar stage 10, stage 20 – 35 Myrelis, the ghost artist I met in the Galmore encampment, informed me that the entrance to Undertell is located just southwest of his building. Myrelis (galmore_58) stage 20, stage 30 – 40 I discovered the heartstone deep inside Undertell, but it was far too hot to move or even touch. Maybe Unnmir knows what I should do next? walking into a blocked passage on undertell_3_lava_01 – – 45 I discovered a heartstone deep inside Undertell. It's time to put Nocmar to work.🗺️ Part of Undertell 10 visibly changes. walking into a blocked passage on undertell_10 – gives 1× Heartstone 48 Nocmar informed me that I must return the unrefined heartstone back to where I found it so it could "become whole".🔒 An area on Undertell 10 becomes blocked off. Nocmar carry 1× Heartstone, carry 1× Heartstone, stage 10, stage 20 – 50 Unnmir told me that the only way to cool the heartstone enough to carry it is to use a block of Galmore ice which he said I could find at the top of Galmore Mountain guarded by the snow beasts. This rare ice does not melt in the lowlands, only when placed against something extremely hot like lava or the heartstone itself. Unnmir stage 40 – 60 I was spooked by a sound causing me to lose my grip on the unrefined heartstone, causing me to drop it. Thus shattering it into pieces.🗺️ Part of Undertell 10 visibly changes. walking into a blocked passage on undertell_10 carry 1× Heartstone, hand over 1× Heartstone applies condition fear 70 I placed the Galmore ice on the heartstone. The block hissed and steamed as it melted away, cooling the heartstone until it was safe to touch. I picked it up at last.🗺️ Part of Undertell 3 lava 01 visibly changes. walking into a blocked passage on undertell_3_lava_01 hand over 1× Galmore ice, stage 50 gives 1× Heartstone 80 I returned to Nocmar with the cooled heartstone. He was eager to begin his work, but... not in his Fallhaven shop. Nocmar stage 10, stage 20 – 90 Nocmar told me to meet him at the glowing white house south of Fallhaven. He says the lock will no longer bar my entry, as he must prepare the forge and make sure the place is safe.⚡ A scripted event can now trigger on Gapfiller2.🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on Gapfiller2. Nocmar – removes monsters from fallhaven_nocmar 100 I met Nocmar inside the glowing white house, where the ever-burning forge waits. He explained that with the heartstone I recovered, he can forge one heartsteel weapon of my choice. Nocmar stage 90 – 110 As I refused a heartsteel weapon from Nocmar, Falkour, the forge dragon beneath the glowing house, gifted me a pendant.👣 Reached by stepping onto a trigger spot on White house basement. walking into a blocked passage on white_house_basementstepping on a trigger on white_house_basement – gives 1× Heartfire pendant of Kazaul 200 Nocmar forged the heartsteel once again and rewarded me with a weapon type of my choice, reforged in the lost art. (completes quest)🔒 An area on White house basement becomes blocked off.🔓 You can finally access a previously blocked area on White house. docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Nocmar refused to forge heartsteel in his shop, fearing discovery by Geomyr's men. He revealed that he once owned a glowing white house south of Fallhaven, where a special forge still burns. That forge was the only place he ever worked heartsteel. But after falling into debt, he lost the house to Alkapoan. If Nocmar is to forge again, I must help him regain it.

Stage Journal entry Triggered by Needs Rewards 10 Nocmar refused to forge heartsteel in his shop, fearing discovery by Geomyr's men. He revealed that he once owned a glowing white house south of Fallhaven, where a special forge still burns. That forge was the only place he ever worked heartsteel. But after falling into debt, he lost the house to Alkapoan. If Nocmar is to forge again, I must help him regain it. Nocmar – – 20 Nocmar told me that Alkapoan holds the deed and key to the glowing white house. He said the forge within never dies, always blazing, ready for work. If I can reclaim the deed and key from Alkapoan, Nocmar will finally have his forge back. Nocmar – – 30 Alkapoan scoffed when I mentioned Nocmar. He said the only way to reclaim the glowing white house is to pay him fifty thousand gold. Nothing else will satisfy him. Mustura (brimhaven4)Alkapoan (brimhaven_house1) – – 35 I told Alkapoan I wanted the glowing white house for myself. He agreed to sell it for forty thousand gold, but only if I first complete a task for him to prove my worth. Mustura (brimhaven4)Alkapoan (brimhaven_house1) – – 40 Alkapoan asked me to collect an overdue 'operation tax' of five thousand gold from a card dealer in the back room of Brimhaven's tavern. I'll need to go there and retrieve the gold for Alkapoan before he will sell me the deed to the white house for forty thousand. Mustura (brimhaven4)Alkapoan (brimhaven_house1) – – 45 I was able to collect the overdue 'operation tax' from the dealer and now I should return to Alkapoan. Dealer (brimhaven_tavern_west_back)stepping on a trigger on brimhaven_tavern_west_back stage 40 gives 5000× Gold coinsgives 6000× Gold coins 50 After I paid Alkapoan, he gave me the deed and the key to the white house south of Fallhaven. I should bring them back to Nocmar. Mustura (brimhaven4)Alkapoan (brimhaven_house1) pay 45,000 gold, stage 45 gives 1× White house deedgives 1× White house key 60 I was able to finally give Nocmar back what was rightfully his...possession of his forge house. (completes quest) Nocmar hand over 1× White house deed, hand over 1× White house key, stage 50 8,975 XP

I should go look for hints near Harlenn's private quarters, but make sure not to be seen. Guthbered (blackwater_mountain29) – – 60 I have found some papers around Harlenn's private quarters outlining a plan to attack Prim. docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Roskelt, the leader of a gang of skeletons, claimed to be king of the caves. He demanded that I would seek out his brother and bring him a message: if he came and surrendered, then he would have the grace of a quick, almost painless death.
